description: Birinchi tanishuvda ishlatiladigan eng kerakli so'zlar.
story: Siz kursda yangi odam bilan tanishyapsiz. U sizning ismingizni, qayerdan ekanligingizni va nima qilishingizni so'raydi. Bugun shu suhbatni to'liq olib chiqa oladigan so'zlarni o'rganamiz.
grammarFocus: to be: I am / you are / he is

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Hello! My name is Aziz. What is your name?
dialogue.uz: Salom! Mening ismim Aziz. Ismingiz nima?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Hello, Aziz. I am Sara. Nice to meet you.
dialogue.uz: Salom, Aziz. Men Saraman. Tanishganimdan xursandman.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you too. Where are you from?
dialogue.uz: Men ham xursandman. Siz qayerdansiz?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: I am from Samarkand, but I live in Tashkent now.
dialogue.uz: Men Samarqanddanman, lekin hozir Toshkentda yashayman.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Are you a student?
dialogue.uz: Siz talabamisiz?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Yes. I am twenty years old and I study English.
dialogue.uz: Ha. Men yigirma yoshdaman va ingliz tilini o'rganaman.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Thank you for your time. See you soon!
dialogue.uz: Vaqtingiz uchun rahmat. Ko'rishguncha!

words.definition: a word you say when you meet someone
words.example: She said hello to her teacher.

words.definition: the word that a person is called by
words.example: My name is Aziz.

words.definition: to see and talk to someone for the first time
words.example: I meet my friends every Sunday.
words.exampleUz: Men har yakshanba do'stlarim bilan uchrashaman.

words.definition: showing where someone or something started
words.example: I am from Samarkand.

words.definition: to have your home in a place
words.example: They live in a small house.

words.definition: a person who studies at a school or university
words.example: He is a student at the university.

words.definition: a period of twelve months
words.example: My sister is ten years old.

words.definition: having lived or existed for a long time
words.example: This book is very old.

words.definition: pleasant or kind
words.example: You have a nice smile.

words.definition: to tell someone you are grateful
words.example: I want to thank my teacher.

description: Oila a'zolari haqida gapirish.
story: Yangi tanishingiz oilangiz haqida so'radi. O'zbek madaniyatida bu eng oddiy suhbat mavzusi — shuning uchun bu so'zlar birinchi kunlardanoq kerak bo'ladi.
grammarFocus: have / has got

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Do you have a big family?
dialogue.uz: Sizning oilangiz kattami?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes. My mother, my father, my brother and my sister live together.
dialogue.uz: Ha. Onam, otam, akam va singlim birga yashaymiz.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Is your brother married?
dialogue.uz: Akangiz uylanganmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes, he has one son and one daughter.
dialogue.uz: Ha, uning bitta o'g'li va bitta qizi bor.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: How old is his daughter?
dialogue.uz: Qizi necha yoshda?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: She is a small child. My grandmother helps with her.
dialogue.uz: U kichkina bola. Buvim unga qaraydi.

words.definition: a group of people who are related to each other
words.example: My family is very important to me.

words.definition: a female parent
words.example: My mother cooks dinner every evening.
words.exampleUz: Onam har kechqurun kechki ovqat tayyorlaydi.

words.definition: a male parent
words.example: His father works in a school.

words.definition: a boy or man with the same parents as you
words.example: My brother plays football.

words.definition: a girl or woman with the same parents as you
words.example: Her sister is a doctor.

words.definition: someone's male child
words.example: They have one son.

words.definition: someone's female child
words.example: My daughter is five years old.

words.definition: the mother of your mother or father
words.example: My grandmother tells good stories.

words.definition: having a husband or wife
words.example: My brother is married.

words.definition: a young boy or girl
words.example: The child is playing in the garden.

description: Soat, kun va vaqtni aytish.
story: Do'stingiz bilan uchrashuv belgilayapsiz. Vaqtni to'g'ri aytolmaslik — boshlang'ich darajadagi eng ko'p uchraydigan muammo. Bugun shuni yopamiz.
grammarFocus: What time is it? / at + time

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: What time is it now?
dialogue.uz: Hozir soat necha?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: It is nine in the morning.
dialogue.uz: Ertalab soat to'qqiz.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Our lesson starts in one hour.
dialogue.uz: Darsimiz bir soatdan keyin boshlanadi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: We have thirty minutes to walk there. Do not be late.
dialogue.uz: U yerga borish uchun o'ttiz daqiqamiz bor. Kechikmang.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Is the lesson today or tomorrow?
dialogue.uz: Dars bugunmi yoki ertagami?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Today. Tomorrow evening we have a free week.
dialogue.uz: Bugun. Ertaga kechqurun bo'sh haftamiz bor.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Give me your phone number, please.
dialogue.uz: Iltimos, telefon raqamingizni bering.

words.definition: the thing we measure in hours and minutes
words.example: What time does the shop open?

words.definition: a period of sixty minutes
words.example: I study for one hour every day.
words.exampleUz: Men har kuni bir soat o'qiyman.

words.definition: a period of sixty seconds
words.example: Please wait ten minutes.

words.definition: the early part of the day
words.example: I drink tea in the morning.

words.definition: the part of the day between afternoon and night
words.example: We watch a film in the evening.

words.definition: on this day
words.example: Today is a beautiful day.

words.definition: on the day after today
words.example: I will call you tomorrow.

words.definition: a period of seven days
words.example: There are seven days in a week.

words.definition: after the expected time
words.example: Do not be late for the lesson.

words.definition: a word or sign such as 1, 2 or 3
words.example: My phone number is easy to remember.

description: Narx so'rash, tanlash va to'lash.
story: Do'konga kirdingiz va sotuvchi bilan gaplashishingiz kerak. Narxni so'rash va "qimmat/arzon" deyish — chet elda birinchi kundan kerak bo'ladigan ko'nikma.
grammarFocus: this / that, How much is it?

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.en: Hello! Can I help you?
dialogue.uz: Salom! Yordam bera olamanmi?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Yes, I need a new bag.
dialogue.uz: Ha, menga yangi sumka kerak.

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.en: This one is a good size. The price is fifty thousand som.
dialogue.uz: Bu yaxshi o'lcham. Narxi ellik ming so'm.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: That is expensive. Do you have a cheap one?
dialogue.uz: Bu qimmat. Arzonrog'i bormi?

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.en: Yes, this bag is cheap and strong.
dialogue.uz: Ha, bu sumka arzon va mustahkam.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Good, I will buy it. Can I pay with money or card?
dialogue.uz: Yaxshi, sotib olaman. Naqd pul yoki karta bilan to'lasam bo'ladimi?

dialogue.speaker: Seller
dialogue.en: Both are fine. Thank you for coming to our shop.
dialogue.uz: Ikkalasi ham bo'ladi. Do'konimizga kelganingiz uchun rahmat.

words.definition: a place where you buy things
words.example: The shop opens at nine.

words.definition: to get something by paying money
words.example: I want to buy some bread.

words.definition: the amount of money you pay for something
words.example: The price of milk is going up.

words.definition: coins and notes used to buy things
words.example: He has no money in his pocket.

words.definition: not costing much money
words.example: This shirt is very cheap.

words.definition: costing a lot of money
words.example: Cars are expensive in our country.

words.definition: to give money for something
words.example: You can pay by card here.
words.exampleUz: Bu yerda karta bilan to'lashingiz mumkin.

words.definition: a container you carry things in
words.example: Put the fruit in the bag.

words.definition: how big or small something is
words.example: What size do you wear?

words.definition: to must have something
words.example: I need a warm coat for winter.
words.exampleUz: Menga qish uchun iliq palto kerak.

description: Ovqat haqida gapirish va nimadir so'rash.
story: Mehmonga bordingiz yoki uyda oila bilan dasturxondasiz. "Ochman", "chanqadim", "choy ichasizmi" — bular kundalik hayotning eng chastotali gaplari.
grammarFocus: countable / uncountable: some, any

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Are you hungry?
dialogue.uz: Qorningiz ochmi?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Yes, very. I want to eat something.
dialogue.uz: Ha, juda. Men nimadir yemoqchiman.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: We have bread, meat and fruit at home.
dialogue.uz: Uyda non, go'sht va meva bor.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: That is good food. I am also thirsty.
dialogue.uz: Bu yaxshi ovqat. Men chanqadim ham.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Do you want to drink water or tea?
dialogue.uz: Suv yoki choy ichasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Green tea, please.
dialogue.uz: Ko'k choy, iltimos.

words.definition: things that people eat
words.example: Uzbek food is delicious.

words.definition: a basic food made from flour
words.example: We buy fresh bread every morning.
words.exampleUz: Biz har kuni ertalab yangi non sotib olamiz.

words.definition: the clear liquid that people drink
words.example: Drink two litres of water a day.

words.definition: a hot drink made from leaves
words.example: My father drinks tea with sugar.

words.definition: the flesh of animals used as food
words.example: She does not eat meat.

words.definition: sweet food that grows on trees and plants
words.example: Apples are my favourite fruit.

words.definition: wanting to eat
words.example: The children are hungry after school.

words.definition: wanting to drink
words.example: I am thirsty after running.

words.definition: to put food in your mouth and swallow it
words.example: We eat dinner at seven.

words.definition: to take liquid into your mouth
words.example: What do you want to drink?

description: Uy va xonalarni tasvirlash.
story: Kimdir sizdan uyingiz haqida so'radi yoki siz ijaraga uy qidiryapsiz. Xonalar va jihozlar nomi — tavsiflash ko'nikmasining asosi.
grammarFocus: there is / there are

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Is your house big or small?
dialogue.uz: Uyingiz kattami yoki kichikmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: It is not big. We have three rooms and a kitchen.
dialogue.uz: Katta emas. Bizda uchta xona va oshxona bor.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Does your room have a window?
dialogue.uz: Xonangizda deraza bormi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes, a big window near the table.
dialogue.uz: Ha, stol yonida katta deraza.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Do you have a chair there too?
dialogue.uz: U yerda stul ham bormi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes. Please close the door — I want to clean the small room.
dialogue.uz: Ha. Iltimos, eshikni yoping — kichik xonani tozalamoqchiman.

words.definition: a building where people live
words.example: Their house has a green roof.

words.definition: a part of a building with walls and a door
words.example: This room is very quiet.

words.definition: the room where you cook food
words.example: Mother is cooking in the kitchen.

words.definition: the thing you open to go into a room
words.example: Please close the door.

words.definition: an opening in a wall with glass
words.example: Open the window, it is hot.

words.definition: a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs
words.example: The food is on the table.

words.definition: a seat for one person
words.example: Sit on this chair, please.

words.definition: to make something free from dirt
words.example: I clean my room on Sunday.

words.definition: large in size
words.example: They live in a big city.

words.definition: not large in size
words.example: We have a small garden.

description: Kun davomida nima qilishingizni aytish.
story: Kundalik tartib haqida gapirish — Present Simple ni mustahkamlashning eng tabiiy yo'li. Bu zamon o'zbek tilida so'zlashuvchilar uchun eng ko'p xato qiladigan joy.
grammarFocus: Present Simple + chastota qo'shimchalari

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: What time do you wake up?
dialogue.uz: Soat nechada uyg'onasiz?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I always wake up at six.
dialogue.uz: Men doim oltida uyg'onaman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: When do you start work?
dialogue.uz: Ishni qachon boshlaysiz?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I start at eight and finish at five. I am usually busy.
dialogue.uz: Sakkizda boshlab beshda tugataman. Men odatda bandman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Are you tired in the evening?
dialogue.uz: Kechqurun charchaysizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes, I sleep early. I never sleep late.
dialogue.uz: Ha, erta uxlayman. Hech qachon kech uxlamayman.

words.definition: to stop sleeping
words.example: I wake up early on Monday.

words.definition: to rest with your eyes closed
words.example: Children need to sleep eight hours.

words.definition: the job a person does
words.example: My father goes to work by bus.

words.definition: to begin doing something
words.example: The lessons start in September.

words.definition: to complete something
words.example: I finish my homework before dinner.
words.exampleUz: Uy vazifamni kechki ovqatdan oldin tugataman.

words.definition: every time; all the time
words.example: She always helps her friends.

words.definition: not at any time
words.example: He never eats fast food.
words.exampleUz: U hech qachon tez tayyor ovqat yemaydi.

words.definition: most of the time
words.example: We usually go home together.

words.definition: having a lot of things to do
words.example: The doctor is busy today.

words.definition: needing rest or sleep
words.example: I am tired after a long day.

description: Ob-havo haqida suhbat boshlash.
story: Ob-havo — dunyoning hamma joyida suhbat boshlash uchun eng xavfsiz mavzu. Bu so'zlarsiz oddiy small talk qilib bo'lmaydi.
grammarFocus: It is + adjective / It is going to rain

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: What is the weather like today?
dialogue.uz: Bugun ob-havo qanday?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: It is cold and there is a strong wind.
dialogue.uz: Sovuq va kuchli shamol bor.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Will it rain?
dialogue.uz: Yomg'ir yog'adimi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Maybe. In winter we also have snow here.
dialogue.uz: Balki. Qishda bu yerda qor ham bo'ladi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Which season do you like?
dialogue.uz: Qaysi faslni yoqtirasiz?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Spring. It is warm and the sun is bright. Summer is too hot.
dialogue.uz: Bahorni. Iliq va quyosh yorqin. Yoz juda issiq.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Take an umbrella — the street is wet.
dialogue.uz: Soyabon oling — ko'cha ho'l.

words.definition: the condition of the air: sun, rain, wind
words.example: The weather is nice in May.

words.definition: having a high temperature
words.example: Tea is too hot to drink now.
words.exampleUz: Choy hozir ichish uchun juda issiq.

words.definition: having a low temperature
words.example: Winter in Tashkent is cold.

words.definition: water that falls from the clouds
words.example: We stayed at home because of the rain.

words.definition: soft white pieces of frozen water that fall from the sky
words.example: The children play in the snow.

words.definition: the star that gives light to the earth
words.example: The sun rises at six.

words.definition: moving air
words.example: A cold wind is blowing.

words.definition: a little hot, in a pleasant way
words.example: Wear a warm jacket.

words.definition: covered with water
words.example: My shoes are wet.

words.definition: one of the four parts of the year
words.example: Autumn is my favourite season.

description: Notanish shaharda yo'l so'rash va tushunish.
story: Notanish shahardasiz va bekatni topa olmayapsiz. Bu yerda eng qiyini — javobni TUSHUNISH. Shuning uchun bugungi so'zlarni eshitib tanish kerak, faqat aytish emas.
grammarFocus: Imperative: go, turn, take

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.en: Excuse me, can you show me the way to the station?
dialogue.uz: Kechirasiz, bekatga yo'lni ko'rsata olasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.en: Yes. Go straight down this street.
dialogue.uz: Ha. Shu ko'cha bo'ylab to'g'riga yuring.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.en: Is it far from here?
dialogue.uz: Bu yerdan uzoqmi?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.en: No, it is near. About five minutes on foot.
dialogue.uz: Yo'q, yaqin. Piyoda taxminan besh daqiqa.

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.en: At the corner, turn left.
dialogue.uz: Burchakda chapga buriling.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.en: Left or right?
dialogue.uz: Chapgami yoki o'nggami?

dialogue.speaker: Local
dialogue.en: Turn left, then the station is on your right.
dialogue.uz: Chapga buriling, keyin bekat o'ng tomoningizda bo'ladi.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.en: Thank you. I have a map but it is not clear.
dialogue.uz: Rahmat. Menda xarita bor, lekin u tushunarli emas.

words.definition: a road in a town with houses on both sides
words.example: Our street is very quiet at night.

words.definition: to change the direction you are going
words.example: Turn right after the bank.

words.definition: on or to the side of your body that is west when you face north
words.example: The shop is on the left.

words.definition: on or to the side opposite the left
words.example: Take the first road on the right.

words.definition: without turning to one side
words.example: Go straight for two hundred metres.

words.definition: the place where two streets meet
words.example: There is a café on the corner.

words.definition: a short distance away
words.example: I live near the school.

words.definition: a long distance away
words.example: The airport is far from the city.

words.definition: the road or path to a place
words.example: Can you show me the way home?

words.definition: a drawing of an area showing roads and places
words.example: I always use a map in a new city.
words.exampleUz: Yangi shaharda men doim xaritadan foydalanaman.

description: Avtobus, poyezd va chipta bilan bog'liq suhbat.
story: Chipta sotib olish va jo'nash vaqtini aniqlash kerak. Bu yerda vaqt jadvali haqidagi Present Simple ishlatiladi — o'zbek tilida so'zlashuvchilar ko'pincha bu yerda Future ishlatib xato qiladi.
grammarFocus: Present Simple jadval uchun: the bus leaves at 8

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: How do you travel to work?
dialogue.uz: Ishga qanday borasiz?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I take the bus. Sometimes I drive.
dialogue.uz: Avtobusda boraman. Ba'zan o'zim haydayman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Where is the bus stop?
dialogue.uz: Avtobus bekati qayerda?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Near the station. You can buy a ticket there.
dialogue.uz: Bekat yonida. U yerdan chipta olsangiz bo'ladi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: What time does the bus leave?
dialogue.uz: Avtobus soat nechada jo'naydi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: It leaves at eight and we arrive at half past eight.
dialogue.uz: Sakkizda jo'naydi va sakkiz yarimda yetib boramiz.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Do we need to wait long?
dialogue.uz: Uzoq kutish kerakmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: No. The train is faster, but the bus is cheaper.
dialogue.uz: Yo'q. Poyezd tezroq, lekin avtobus arzonroq.

words.definition: a large vehicle that carries many passengers
words.example: The bus is full in the morning.

words.definition: a vehicle that travels on rails
words.example: The train to Bukhara is fast.

words.definition: a paper that shows you paid to travel
words.example: I lost my ticket.

words.definition: a place where buses or trains stop
words.example: We met at the station.

words.definition: to control a car and make it move
words.example: My sister can drive a car.

words.definition: to stay somewhere until something happens
words.example: Please wait for me here.

words.definition: to reach a place
words.example: They arrive at nine o'clock.

words.definition: to go away from a place
words.example: We leave home at seven.

words.definition: to no longer move or continue
words.example: The bus does not stop here.

words.definition: to go from one place to another
words.example: I like to travel by train.

description: Menyu, buyurtma va hisob.
story: Kafeda o'tiribsiz va ofitsiant keldi. "I want" o'rniga "I would like" ishlatish — bu bitta o'zgarish sizni qo'pol emas, madaniyatli qiladi.
grammarFocus: Would like / Can I have …?

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.en: Good afternoon. Here is the menu.
dialogue.uz: Xayrli kun. Mana menyu.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Thank you. I need a minute to choose.
dialogue.uz: Rahmat. Tanlash uchun bir daqiqa kerak.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.en: Are you ready to order?
dialogue.uz: Buyurtma berishga tayyormisiz?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Yes. One coffee with sugar, please. And a dessert.
dialogue.uz: Ha. Bitta qahva, shakar bilan. Va shirinlik.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.en: Our cake is very delicious.
dialogue.uz: Bizning tortimiz juda mazali.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Perfect. A cup of coffee and that cake.
dialogue.uz: Zo'r. Bir piyola qahva va o'sha tort.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Excuse me, waiter! Can I have the bill, please?
dialogue.uz: Kechirasiz, ofitsiant! Iltimos, hisobni bera olasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.en: Of course. One moment.
dialogue.uz: Albatta. Bir daqiqa.

words.definition: to ask for food or drink in a restaurant
words.example: We order pizza every Friday.
words.exampleUz: Biz har juma pitsa buyurtma qilamiz.

words.definition: a list of the food a restaurant serves
words.example: The menu has ten kinds of soup.

words.definition: a person who serves food in a restaurant
words.example: The waiter brought our food quickly.

words.definition: a hot dark drink made from beans
words.example: I drink coffee without sugar.

words.definition: a sweet white substance added to food
words.example: Add two spoons of sugar.

words.definition: a piece of paper showing how much you must pay
words.example: The bill was thirty thousand som.

words.definition: having a very good taste
words.example: This soup is delicious.

words.definition: sweet food eaten at the end of a meal
words.example: We had ice cream for dessert.

words.definition: a small container you drink from
words.example: She broke a cup this morning.

words.definition: to decide which thing you want
words.example: It is hard to choose a good film.

description: Kiyim tanlash, o'lcham va rang.
story: Kiyim do'konidasiz. "Kiyib ko'rsam bo'ladimi?" va "menga to'g'ri kelmadi" — bu ikki gap butun jarayonni hal qiladi.
grammarFocus: Comparatives: bigger, cheaper, warmer

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: I want to buy new clothes for winter.
dialogue.uz: Qish uchun yangi kiyim olmoqchiman.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: What do you need?
dialogue.uz: Sizga nima kerak?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: A warm coat and shoes.
dialogue.uz: Iliq palto va oyoq kiyim.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: What colour do you like?
dialogue.uz: Qaysi rangni yoqtirasiz?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Dark blue. Can I try this coat?
dialogue.uz: To'q ko'k. Bu paltoni kiyib ko'rsam bo'ladimi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes. Does it fit you?
dialogue.uz: Ha. Sizga to'g'ri keldimi?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: It is a little big. This cotton shirt is nice too.
dialogue.uz: Biroz katta. Bu paxta ko'ylak ham chiroyli.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: And that dress? You can wear it to the party.
dialogue.uz: Anavi ko'ylakchi? Uni ziyofatga kiysangiz bo'ladi.

words.definition: things people wear such as shirts and trousers
words.example: Put your clothes in the wardrobe.

words.definition: to have clothes on your body
words.example: I wear a jacket in autumn.

words.definition: a piece of clothing for the upper body with buttons
words.example: His shirt is white.

words.definition: things you wear on your feet
words.example: These shoes are too small.

words.definition: a long warm piece of clothing worn outside
words.example: Take your coat, it is cold outside.

words.definition: red, blue, green and so on
words.example: Red is my favourite colour.

words.definition: to test something to see if it is suitable
words.example: Can I try these shoes?
words.exampleUz: Bu oyoq kiyimlarni kiyib ko'rsam bo'ladimi?

words.definition: to be the right size for someone
words.example: This jacket does not fit me.

words.definition: a piece of clothing worn by women
words.example: She bought a long dress.

words.definition: a soft material made from a plant
words.example: Cotton is soft and light.

description: Og'riqni tushuntirish va maslahat olish.
story: Chet elda kasal bo'lib qolish — eng qo'rqinchli holat. "Qayeringiz og'riyapti?" savoliga javob bera olish tom ma'noda kerak bo'ladi.
grammarFocus: I have a … / It hurts / You should …

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.en: Good morning. What is the problem?
dialogue.uz: Xayrli tong. Muammo nima?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I feel ill. I have a bad headache.
dialogue.uz: O'zimni kasal his qilyapman. Boshim qattiq og'riyapti.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.en: Do you have a fever?
dialogue.uz: Isitmangiz bormi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes, since yesterday. My throat hurts too.
dialogue.uz: Ha, kechadan beri. Tomog'im ham og'riyapti.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.en: Where is the pain?
dialogue.uz: Og'riq qayerda?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Here. Is it serious?
dialogue.uz: Mana bu yerda. Jiddiymi?

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.en: No. Take this medicine and rest at home.
dialogue.uz: Yo'q. Bu dorini iching va uyda dam oling.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.en: You will feel better in two days. Your health is good.
dialogue.uz: Ikki kunda o'zingizni yaxshiroq his qilasiz. Salomatligingiz yaxshi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Thank you, doctor. Should I come again next week?
dialogue.uz: Rahmat, shifokor. Keyingi hafta yana kelaymi?

words.definition: a person trained to treat ill people
words.example: You should see a doctor today.

words.definition: not healthy; sick
words.example: My brother is ill and cannot come.

words.definition: the feeling you have when part of your body hurts
words.example: The pain in my back is strong.

words.definition: something you take to treat an illness
words.example: Take this medicine after food.

words.definition: a pain in your head
words.example: I have a headache every evening.

words.definition: a body temperature that is too high
words.example: The child has a high fever.

words.definition: to stop working and relax
words.example: You need to rest for a week.

words.definition: of a higher quality; less ill than before
words.example: I feel better after sleeping.
words.exampleUz: Uxlagandan keyin o'zimni yaxshiroq his qilyapman.

words.definition: to feel pain, or to cause pain
words.example: My legs hurt after the long walk.

words.definition: the condition of your body
words.example: Good health is more important than money.

description: Telefon suhbatining standart iboralari.
story: Telefonda gaplashish yuzma-yuzdan qiyinroq: imo-ishora yo'q, ovoz sifati past. "Qaytaring iltimos" deya olish — bu yerdagi eng muhim ko'nikma.
grammarFocus: Can I …? / Could you …? — muloyim so'rov

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Hello, can I speak to Sara?
dialogue.uz: Salom, Sara bilan gaplasha olamanmi?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Speaking. Who is this?
dialogue.uz: Men tinglayapman. Kim bu?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: It is Aziz. Sorry, I cannot hear you well.
dialogue.uz: Bu Aziz. Kechirasiz, sizni yaxshi eshitolmayapman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: The line is bad. Your voice is very quiet.
dialogue.uz: Liniya yomon. Ovozingiz juda past.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Can you repeat that, please?
dialogue.uz: Iltimos, buni takrorlay olasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: I said I will call you later.
dialogue.uz: Sizga keyinroq qo'ng'iroq qilaman dedim.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Fine. If I do not answer, send me a message.
dialogue.uz: Yaxshi. Agar javob bermasam, menga xabar yuboring.

words.definition: to telephone someone
words.example: I will call my mother tonight.

words.definition: to reply to a question or a phone call
words.example: Nobody will answer the phone.

words.definition: written or spoken information you send someone
words.example: She sent me a short message.

words.definition: to say words; to talk to someone
words.example: Do you speak English?

words.definition: to notice a sound with your ears
words.example: I cannot hear the music.

words.definition: to say or do something again
words.example: Please repeat your question.

words.definition: at a time in the future
words.example: We can talk about it later.

words.definition: used to apologise
words.example: I am sorry for being late.

words.definition: the sound you make when you speak
words.example: Her voice is very soft.

words.definition: a telephone connection
words.example: The line is busy right now.

description: Taklif qilish, rozi bo'lish va vaqt kelishish.
story: Do'stingiz sizni ziyofatga taklif qilmoqchi. Taklifni qabul qilish yoki muloyim rad etish — ijtimoiy hayotning asosi.
grammarFocus: be going to / Are you free …?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Are you free this weekend?
dialogue.uz: Shu dam olish kunlari bo'shmisiz?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I think so. Do you have a plan?
dialogue.uz: O'ylashimcha, ha. Rejangiz bormi?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: I want to invite you to a party on Saturday.
dialogue.uz: Sizni shanba kuni ziyofatga taklif qilmoqchiman.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: That is a good idea. Who else is coming?
dialogue.uz: Bu yaxshi fikr. Yana kim keladi?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Some friends from work. We can go together.
dialogue.uz: Ishdagi bir necha do'st. Birga borsak bo'ladi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Maybe I will be a little late.
dialogue.uz: Balki biroz kechikaman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: No problem. Are you ready by seven?
dialogue.uz: Muammo yo'q. Yettiga tayyor bo'lasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes, I agree. See you then.
dialogue.uz: Ha, roziman. Ko'rishguncha.

words.definition: an idea about what you will do
words.example: Our plan is to leave early.

words.definition: not busy; having no work to do
words.example: I am free after five o'clock.

words.definition: to ask someone to come to an event
words.example: They will invite all their neighbours.

words.definition: an event where people meet to enjoy themselves
words.example: The party starts at eight.

words.definition: Saturday and Sunday
words.example: We rest at the weekend.
words.exampleUz: Biz dam olish kunlari dam olamiz.

words.definition: with each other
words.example: Let us study together.

words.definition: possibly; perhaps
words.example: Maybe it will rain tomorrow.

words.definition: a thought or plan in your mind
words.example: That is a very good idea.

words.definition: to have the same opinion as someone
words.example: I agree with your opinion.

words.definition: prepared for something
words.example: Dinner is ready.

description: Kasb, ish joyi va vazifalar haqida gapirish.
story: Kasbingiz haqida gapirish — tanishuvdan keyingi ikkinchi savol. "I am engineer" emas, "I am AN engineer" — artikl o'zbeklar uchun eng ko'p xato qiladigan joy.
grammarFocus: a / an kasb nomlari bilan: I am an engineer

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: What is your job?
dialogue.uz: Kasbingiz nima?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I am an engineer. I work in a small company.
dialogue.uz: Men muhandisman. Kichik kompaniyada ishlayman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Do you like your office?
dialogue.uz: Ofisingiz yoqadimi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes, and my boss is kind. We have a meeting every Monday.
dialogue.uz: Ha, boshlig'im ham mehribon. Har dushanba uchrashuvimiz bo'ladi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Is the salary good?
dialogue.uz: Maosh yaxshimi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: It is fine. My sister is a teacher and earns less.
dialogue.uz: Yomon emas. Opam o'qituvchi va kamroq oladi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: I want to apply for a new job.
dialogue.uz: Men yangi ishga ariza bermoqchiman.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: You have good experience. You will find one.
dialogue.uz: Sizda yaxshi tajriba bor. Albatta topasiz.

words.definition: the work a person does to earn money
words.example: She found a new job last month.
words.exampleUz: U o'tgan oy yangi ish topdi.

words.definition: a person whose job is to teach
words.example: Our teacher explains everything clearly.

words.definition: a person who designs or builds machines and structures
words.example: He works as an engineer.

words.definition: a room or building where people work at desks
words.example: The office is on the third floor.

words.definition: the money you receive for your work each month
words.example: The salary is paid every month.

words.definition: the person who is in charge of you at work
words.example: My boss asked for the report.

words.definition: an event where people come together to talk
words.example: The meeting will take one hour.

words.definition: knowledge you get from doing something
words.example: You need three years of experience.

words.definition: to make a formal request for a job
words.example: I want to apply for this position.

words.definition: a business that sells goods or services
words.example: The company has fifty workers.

description: Xona band qilish va mehmonxonada muloqot.
story: Mehmonxonaga yetib keldingiz. Bron, kalit, nechta kecha — bu to'rt-besh gap sizni butun jarayondan olib o'tadi.
grammarFocus: Present Perfect: Have you booked …?

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.en: Good evening. I have a booking for two nights.
dialogue.uz: Xayrli kech. Menda ikki kechalik bron bor.

dialogue.speaker: Reception
dialogue.en: May I see your passport, please?
dialogue.uz: Iltimos, pasportingizni ko'rsam bo'ladimi?

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.en: Here it is. Is breakfast included?
dialogue.uz: Mana. Nonushta narxga kiradimi?

dialogue.speaker: Reception
dialogue.en: Yes, from seven to ten. Here is your key.
dialogue.uz: Ha, yettidan o'ngacha. Mana kalitingiz.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.en: Thank you. Where is my luggage?
dialogue.uz: Rahmat. Yukim qayerda?

dialogue.speaker: Reception
dialogue.en: Our staff will bring it to your room.
dialogue.uz: Xodimlarimiz uni xonangizga olib chiqadi.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.en: One more question — do you have a tour to the old city?
dialogue.uz: Yana bir savol — eski shaharga sayohat bormi?

dialogue.speaker: Reception
dialogue.en: Yes, the guide leaves every morning at nine.
dialogue.uz: Ha, gid har kuni ertalab to'qqizda jo'naydi.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.en: Perfect. It is my first time abroad.
dialogue.uz: Zo'r. Bu mening chet eldagi birinchi safarim.

words.definition: an arrangement to have a room or seat kept for you
words.example: I made a booking for Friday.

words.definition: an official document you need to travel abroad
words.example: Do not forget your passport.

words.definition: the first meal of the day
words.example: We have breakfast at eight.

words.definition: a small metal object used to open a lock
words.example: I cannot find my key.

words.definition: the bags you take when you travel
words.example: My luggage is very heavy.

words.definition: the dark part of the day
words.example: We stayed for three nights.

words.definition: a person who shows a place to visitors
words.example: The guide spoke very good English.
words.exampleUz: Gid juda yaxshi ingliz tilida gapirdi.

words.definition: a short journey to see a place
words.example: The tour takes two hours.

words.definition: in or to a foreign country
words.example: She has never been abroad.
words.exampleUz: U hech qachon chet elda bo'lmagan.

words.definition: the people who work for an organisation
words.example: The hotel staff were very friendly.

description: Bankda hisob ochish va pul almashtirish.
story: Bankka kirdingiz: hisob ochish, valyuta almashtirish yoki kartani blokdan chiqarish kerak. Bu so'zlarsiz muammoni tushuntirib bo'lmaydi.
grammarFocus: much / many, a lot of

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.en: Good morning. I want to open a bank account.
dialogue.uz: Xayrli tong. Bank hisobi ochmoqchiman.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.en: Of course. Do you want a debit card too?
dialogue.uz: Albatta. Debet karta ham kerakmi?

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.en: Yes, please. What is the monthly cost?
dialogue.uz: Ha, iltimos. Oylik narxi qancha?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.en: It is free for students. Do you want to change money as well?
dialogue.uz: Talabalar uchun bepul. Pul almashtirmoqchimisiz ham?

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.en: Yes, I need to change dollars into som.
dialogue.uz: Ha, dollarni so'mga almashtirishim kerak.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.en: The rate today is good. How much do you want to exchange?
dialogue.uz: Bugungi kurs yaxshi. Qancha almashtirmoqchisiz?

dialogue.speaker: Client
dialogue.en: Two hundred. Can I also save some money in the account?
dialogue.uz: Ikki yuz. Hisobda biroz pul jamg'arsam ham bo'ladimi?

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.en: Yes, and you will earn a small interest.
dialogue.uz: Ha, va kichik foiz olasiz.

words.definition: a place that keeps money for people
words.example: The bank closes at four.

words.definition: an arrangement to keep money in a bank
words.example: She opened an account last year.

words.definition: a small plastic card used to pay
words.example: My card does not work.

words.definition: the amount of money needed to buy something
words.example: What is the cost of the ticket?

words.definition: to exchange one thing for another
words.example: I want to change dollars into som.

words.definition: to give something and receive something else
words.example: Where can I exchange currency?

words.definition: the value of one currency compared with another
words.example: The rate today is good.

words.definition: to keep money to use later
words.example: I save some money every month.
words.exampleUz: Men har oy biroz pul jamg'araman.

words.definition: to receive money for work
words.example: Teachers earn less than engineers.

words.definition: money a bank pays you for keeping money there
words.example: The interest is two per cent.

description: Internet, ilova va texnik muammolar.
story: Internet ishlamayapti yoki ilovaga kira olmayapsiz. Texnik muammoni tushuntirish — bugungi dunyoda kundalik ehtiyoj.
grammarFocus: Modal: can't, doesn't work

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: My internet is very slow today.
dialogue.uz: Bugun internetim juda sekin.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Did you restart the router?
dialogue.uz: Routerni qayta yoqdingizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Yes, but the connection is still bad.
dialogue.uz: Ha, lekin ulanish hali ham yomon.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Can you open any website?
dialogue.uz: Biror sayt ochilyaptimi?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: No. And this app does not work on my phone.
dialogue.uz: Yo'q. Va bu ilova telefonimda ishlamayapti.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Maybe you need to update it.
dialogue.uz: Balki uni yangilash kerakdir.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: I forgot my password too.
dialogue.uz: Parolimni ham unutdim.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Click on the link and download the new version.
dialogue.uz: Havolani bosing va yangi versiyani yuklab oling.

words.definition: the global computer network
words.example: The internet is very slow today.

words.definition: a link between devices or to a network
words.example: The connection is not stable.

words.definition: a place on the internet with pages of information
words.example: Their website is easy to use.

words.definition: a program you use on a phone or computer
words.example: This app helps me learn words.
words.exampleUz: Bu ilova menga so'z o'rganishga yordam beradi.

words.definition: a device used to call people
words.example: My phone battery is low.

words.definition: a secret word that lets you enter an account
words.example: Choose a strong password.

words.definition: to make something more modern or current
words.example: You should update the program.

words.definition: to copy a file from the internet to your device
words.example: I will download the file now.

words.definition: to press a button on a mouse or screen
words.example: Click on the blue button.

words.definition: not moving or working quickly
words.example: My computer is very slow.

description: Sevimli mashg'ulotlar haqida gapirish.
story: Bo'sh vaqtingizda nima qilasiz? Bu savol har qanday suhbatni davom ettiradi. "I like swimming" — gerundiy bilan tuzilma bu yerda mashq qilinadi.
grammarFocus: like / love / hate + -ing

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: What sport do you play?
dialogue.uz: Qaysi sport bilan shug'ullanasiz?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: I love swimming. And I run twice a week.
dialogue.uz: Suzishni yaxshi ko'raman. Va haftada ikki marta yuguraman.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Do you go to a gym?
dialogue.uz: Sport zaliga borasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Yes, near my house. What about you?
dialogue.uz: Ha, uyim yonida. Sizchi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I prefer team games. I am a member of a football club.
dialogue.uz: Men jamoaviy o'yinlarni afzal ko'raman. Futbol klubi a'zosiman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Did you win your last match?
dialogue.uz: Oxirgi o'yinda yutdingizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: No, we lost. But nobody likes to lose, right?
dialogue.uz: Yo'q, yutqazdik. Lekin hech kim yutqazishni yoqtirmaydi-ku?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: In my free time I also enjoy reading.
dialogue.uz: Bo'sh vaqtimda men kitob o'qishni ham yoqtiraman.

words.definition: a physical game or activity
words.example: Football is a popular sport.

words.definition: the activity of moving through water
words.example: Swimming is good for your back.

words.definition: to move quickly on your feet
words.example: I run in the park every morning.

words.definition: a place with equipment for exercise
words.example: The gym opens at six.

words.definition: a group of people who play or work together
words.example: Our team won the cup.

words.definition: an organisation for people with the same interest
words.example: He joined a chess club.

words.definition: a sports game between two teams or players
words.example: The match starts at six.

words.definition: to be the best in a game or competition
words.example: I hope we win tomorrow.

words.definition: to not win a game or competition
words.example: It is not bad to lose sometimes.

words.definition: to get pleasure from something
words.example: I enjoy listening to music.

description: Dars, imtihon va o'qish jarayoni.
story: O'qish tajribangiz haqida gapirasiz. Bu yerda Past Simple mashq qilinadi — o'zbek tilida so'zlashuvchilar noto'g'ri fe'llarda ko'p xato qiladi.
grammarFocus: Past Simple: studied, passed, failed

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Where did you study?
dialogue.uz: Qayerda o'qigansiz?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: At a technical university. I studied five years.
dialogue.uz: Texnika universitetida. Besh yil o'qidim.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Was the exam difficult?
dialogue.uz: Imtihon qiyin edimi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Very. But I passed with a good mark.
dialogue.uz: Juda. Lekin yaxshi baho bilan o'tdim.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Did anyone fail?
dialogue.uz: Kimdir yiqildimi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Two students failed and repeated the course.
dialogue.uz: Ikki talaba yiqildi va kursni qayta o'qidi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: What was your favourite subject?
dialogue.uz: Sevimli faningiz nima edi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Mathematics. Our lesson was always interesting.
dialogue.uz: Matematika. Darsimiz doim qiziqarli bo'lardi.

words.definition: to learn about a subject
words.example: I study English every day.
words.exampleUz: Men har kuni ingliz tilini o'rganaman.

words.definition: a place of higher education
words.example: She works at a university.

words.definition: an official test of knowledge
words.example: The exam lasts two hours.

words.definition: to succeed in an exam
words.example: I hope you pass the test.

words.definition: to not succeed in an exam
words.example: He was afraid to fail.

words.definition: a number or letter showing how well you did
words.example: She got the highest mark.

words.definition: a period of time when you are taught something
words.example: The lesson lasts forty minutes.

words.definition: an area of knowledge studied at school
words.example: History is an interesting subject.

words.definition: a series of lessons on a subject
words.example: I finished an online course.

words.definition: not easy to do or understand
words.example: This question is difficult.

description: Fikringizni aytish va sabab keltirish.
story: Fikr bildirish A2 dan B1 ga o'tishdagi eng muhim ko'nikma. "I think … because …" tuzilmasi butun gapiring bo'limining asosi.
grammarFocus: because / but / so — sabab va qarama-qarshilik

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: What do you think about online learning?
dialogue.uz: Onlayn ta'lim haqida qanday fikrdasiz?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: In my opinion it is useful, because you save time.
dialogue.uz: Menimcha, u foydali, chunki vaqtni tejaysiz.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: I disagree. I prefer a real classroom.
dialogue.uz: Men qo'shilmayman. Men haqiqiy sinfni afzal ko'raman.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Why do you prefer that?
dialogue.uz: Nega buni afzal ko'rasiz?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Because I can ask the teacher immediately. That is the main reason.
dialogue.uz: Chunki o'qituvchidan darhol so'ray olaman. Asosiy sabab shu.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: That is an important point. Perhaps both are good.
dialogue.uz: Bu muhim fikr. Balki ikkalasi ham yaxshidir.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Yes. It depends on the person.
dialogue.uz: Ha. Bu odamga bog'liq.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I am sure you are right about that.
dialogue.uz: Bunda siz haqsiz deb ishonaman.

words.definition: to have an opinion or belief
words.example: I think this book is useful.

words.definition: what you believe about something
words.example: Everyone has a different opinion.

words.definition: for the reason that
words.example: I stayed home because it was raining.
words.exampleUz: Uyda qoldim, chunki yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi.

words.definition: why something happens
words.example: Tell me the reason for your decision.

words.definition: having a great effect or value
words.example: This is an important decision.

words.definition: to have a different opinion
words.example: I disagree with that idea.

words.definition: to like one thing more than another
words.example: I prefer tea to coffee.

words.definition: helpful for a purpose
words.example: This advice is very useful.

words.definition: certain about something
words.example: Are you sure about the time?

words.definition: possibly; maybe
words.example: Perhaps we should wait.

description: Tashqi ko'rinish va xarakterni tasvirlash.
story: Kimnidir tasvirlash kerak — do'stingiznimi, hamkasbingiznimi. Tashqi ko'rinish va xarakter sifatlari bu yerda birga o'rganiladi.
grammarFocus: Sifatlar tartibi: a tall young man

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Can you describe your new colleague?
dialogue.uz: Yangi hamkasbingizni tasvirlab bera olasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: He is a tall young man with short dark hair.
dialogue.uz: U qisqa qora sochli, baland bo'yli yigit.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: What is his character like?
dialogue.uz: Xarakteri qanday?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Very polite and quiet. He never shouts.
dialogue.uz: Juda muloyim va tinch. U hech qachon baqirmaydi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Is he friendly with the team?
dialogue.uz: Jamoa bilan do'stonami?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes, and he is honest. Everybody trusts him.
dialogue.uz: Ha, va u halol. Hamma unga ishonadi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Is he strong enough for this hard job?
dialogue.uz: Bu og'ir ish uchun u yetarlicha kuchlimi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I think so. He looks serious about it.
dialogue.uz: Menimcha, ha. U bunga jiddiy qaraydi.

words.definition: to say what someone or something is like
words.example: Can you describe the man you saw?

words.definition: having a greater than average height
words.example: Her brother is very tall.

words.definition: not old; having lived a short time
words.example: A young man asked for help.

words.definition: the thin threads that grow on your head

words.definition: the qualities that make a person who they are

words.definition: behaving in a respectful way

words.definition: making little noise; not talking much

words.definition: behaving in a kind and pleasant way

words.definition: always telling the truth

words.definition: having a lot of physical power
words.example: He is strong enough to lift it.

description: Ish suhbatida o'zingizni tanishtirish.
story: Kursning yakuni: ish suhbati. Bu yerda oldingi 23 kunning hammasi birlashadi — tanishuv, tajriba, fikr bildirish, kelajak rejalari.
grammarFocus: Present Perfect: I have worked … for three years

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.en: Welcome. Thank you for coming to the interview.
dialogue.uz: Xush kelibsiz. Suhbatga kelganingiz uchun rahmat.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.en: Tell me about your background, please.
dialogue.uz: Iltimos, o'zingiz haqingizda gapirib bering.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I have worked as an engineer for three years.
dialogue.uz: Men uch yildan beri muhandis bo'lib ishlayman.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.en: What are your main skills?
dialogue.uz: Asosiy ko'nikmalaringiz nima?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I can solve difficult problems and I learn quickly.
dialogue.uz: Men qiyin muammolarni yecha olaman va tez o'rganaman.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.en: Why do you want to join our team?
dialogue.uz: Nega bizning jamoamizga qo'shilmoqchisiz?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Your projects are interesting and I want to grow.
dialogue.uz: Loyihalaringiz qiziqarli va men o'sishni xohlayman.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.en: What is your biggest weakness?
dialogue.uz: Eng katta kamchiligingiz nima?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Sometimes I am too careful, so I work slowly. I am improving that.
dialogue.uz: Ba'zan juda ehtiyotkorman, shuning uchun sekin ishlayman. Buni yaxshilayapman.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.en: Thank you. We will contact you next week.
dialogue.uz: Rahmat. Keyingi hafta siz bilan bog'lanamiz.

words.definition: a formal meeting where you are asked questions for a job
words.example: The interview went well.

words.definition: your education and work history

words.definition: the ability to do something well

words.definition: to find an answer to a problem

words.definition: a difficult situation that needs a solution

words.definition: to become a member of a group
words.example: I want to join your company.

words.definition: a planned piece of work
words.example: The project takes six months.

words.definition: to develop and become better or bigger
words.example: I want to grow in my career.

words.definition: a quality that is not strong
words.example: Everyone has a weakness.

words.definition: to communicate with someone
words.example: We will contact you next week.

description: O'tmishdagi odatlar va xotiralar haqida gapirish.
story: Kimdir sizdan bolaligingiz haqida so'radi. Bu yerda `used to` tuzilmasi mashq qilinadi — o'zbek tilida so'zlashuvchilar uni ko'pincha oddiy o'tgan zamon bilan almashtirib yuboradi.
grammarFocus: used to / would — o'tmishdagi takroriy harakatlar

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Do you often think about your childhood?
dialogue.uz: Bolaligingiz haqida tez-tez o'ylaysizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes. I have a clear memory of our old neighbourhood.
dialogue.uz: Ha. Eski mahallamiz haqida aniq xotiram bor.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: What did you use to do there?
dialogue.uz: U yerda nima qilardingiz?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: We played on the playground until dark. I miss those days.
dialogue.uz: Qorong'i tushguncha o'yin maydonchasida o'ynardik. O'sha kunlarni sog'inaman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Do you still remember your neighbours?
dialogue.uz: Qo'shnilaringizni hali eslaysizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Some of them. But I forget the names now.
dialogue.uz: Ba'zilarini. Lekin ismlarini endi unutyapman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Do you have any photographs?
dialogue.uz: Suratlaringiz bormi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: A few. I was a teenager when we moved away.
dialogue.uz: Bir nechta. Ko'chib ketganimizda men o'smir edim.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Every moment of that time matters, doesn't it?
dialogue.uz: O'sha davrning har bir lahzasi qadrli-ku?

words.definition: something you remember from the past
words.example: I have a clear memory of that day.
words.exampleUz: O'sha kun haqida aniq xotiram bor.

words.definition: the time when you are a child
words.example: She had a happy childhood.

words.definition: to keep something in your mind from the past
words.example: I remember his face but not his name.
words.exampleUz: Uning yuzini eslayman, ismini esa yo'q.

words.definition: to be unable to remember
words.example: Do not forget to call her.

words.definition: a very short period of time
words.example: That was the best moment of my life.
words.exampleUz: Bu hayotimdagi eng yaxshi lahza edi.

words.definition: the area around where you live
words.example: Our neighbourhood is quiet and safe.

words.definition: an outdoor area where children play
words.example: The playground is full of children.

words.definition: a person between 13 and 19 years old
words.example: My son is a teenager now.

words.definition: a picture made with a camera
words.example: She showed me an old photograph.

words.definition: to feel sad because someone or something is not with you
words.example: I miss my family very much.

description: Odatlar, ovqatlanish va sog'lom turmush.
story: Turmush tarzingizni o'zgartirdingiz va buni tushuntirib berishingiz kerak. Maslahat berish tuzilmalari bu yerda tabiiy mashq qilinadi.
grammarFocus: should / ought to — maslahat berish

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: You look full of energy today.
dialogue.uz: Bugun juda tetik ko'rinasiz.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I changed my diet and I exercise regularly now.
dialogue.uz: Ovqatlanishimni o'zgartirdim va endi muntazam mashq qilaman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Was it hard to build the habit?
dialogue.uz: Odat shakllantirish qiyin bo'ldimi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: The first month, yes. I had to avoid fast food completely.
dialogue.uz: Birinchi oy — ha. Tez tayyor ovqatdan butunlay voz kechishga to'g'ri keldi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Did you lose weight?
dialogue.uz: Vazn tashladingizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: A little. But the main thing is less stress.
dialogue.uz: Bir oz. Lekin asosiysi — stress kamaydi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: I should quit coffee too.
dialogue.uz: Men ham qahvani tashlashim kerak.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Small regular changes work better than big ones. Now I feel healthy.
dialogue.uz: Kichik muntazam o'zgarishlar kattalaridan yaxshiroq ishlaydi. Endi o'zimni sog'lom his qilaman.

words.definition: physically well and strong
words.example: A healthy person sleeps well.

words.definition: to do physical activity to stay fit
words.example: I exercise three times a week.
words.exampleUz: Men haftada uch marta mashq qilaman.

words.definition: the food a person usually eats
words.example: A balanced diet is important.

words.definition: something you do regularly, often without thinking
words.example: Reading before bed is a good habit.

words.definition: worry caused by a difficult situation
words.example: Too much work causes stress.
words.exampleUz: Haddan ziyod ish stressga olib keladi.

words.definition: to stay away from something
words.example: Try to avoid sugar in the evening.
words.exampleUz: Kechqurun shakardan voz kechishga harakat qiling.

words.definition: how heavy someone or something is
words.example: He lost ten kilos of weight.

words.definition: the strength to be active
words.example: I have no energy after work.

words.definition: happening at the same time repeatedly
words.example: Regular sleep improves memory.

words.definition: to stop doing something
words.example: He decided to quit smoking.

description: Ekologik muammolar va yechimlar.
story: Ekologiya haqidagi suhbat — B1 darajadagi eng ko'p uchraydigan imtihon mavzularidan biri. Bu yerda majhul nisbat tabiiy ravishda ishlatiladi.
grammarFocus: Passive voice: is thrown away, must be done

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Our city has a serious pollution problem.
dialogue.uz: Shahrimizda jiddiy ifloslanish muammosi bor.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes, and too much plastic is thrown away every day.
dialogue.uz: Ha, va har kuni juda ko'p plastik chiqindiga tashlanadi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Do people recycle here?
dialogue.uz: Bu yerda odamlar qayta ishlashga topshiradimi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Some do. But most rubbish is not separated.
dialogue.uz: Ba'zilar topshiradi. Lekin ko'p axlat ajratilmaydi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: We should reduce waste at home first.
dialogue.uz: Avval uyda chiqindini kamaytirishimiz kerak.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: True. Small actions protect the environment.
dialogue.uz: To'g'ri. Kichik harakatlar atrof-muhitni asraydi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Climate change is already causing damage.
dialogue.uz: Iqlim o'zgarishi allaqachon zarar keltirmoqda.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: That is why the government must act now.
dialogue.uz: Shuning uchun hukumat hozir harakat qilishi kerak.

words.definition: the natural world around us
words.example: We must look after the environment.

words.definition: harmful substances in air, water or land
words.example: Air pollution is worse in winter.

words.definition: material that is thrown away
words.example: The factory produces a lot of waste.

words.definition: to treat used materials so they can be used again
words.example: We recycle paper and glass.
words.exampleUz: Biz qog'oz va shishani qayta ishlashga topshiramiz.

words.definition: a light artificial material
words.example: Plastic bags harm animals.

words.definition: to keep someone or something safe
words.example: Trees protect the soil.

words.definition: the usual weather conditions of an area
words.example: The climate is changing quickly.

words.definition: physical harm to something
words.example: The storm caused serious damage.

words.definition: to make something smaller in amount
words.example: We need to reduce our water use.

words.definition: things you throw away
words.example: Please take the rubbish outside.

description: Ekran vaqti, maxfiylik va tarmoqlar.
story: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar haqida fikr bildirish. Bu mavzu suhbatda ham, imtihonda ham eng ko'p uchraydiganlardan.
grammarFocus: Present Perfect Continuous: I have been using…

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: How much time do you spend in front of a screen?
dialogue.uz: Ekran oldida qancha vaqt o'tkazasiz?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Too much. I think I am addicted to my device.
dialogue.uz: Juda ko'p. O'ylashimcha, qurilmamga qaram bo'lib qolganman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Which network do you use most?
dialogue.uz: Qaysi tarmoqdan ko'proq foydalanasiz?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Instagram. But I only share content with close friends.
dialogue.uz: Instagram. Lekin kontentni faqat yaqin do'stlar bilan bo'lishaman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Are you worried about privacy?
dialogue.uz: Maxfiylik haqida tashvishlanasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes. People comment on everything now.
dialogue.uz: Ha. Endi odamlar hamma narsaga izoh yozadi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Technology is useful, but it can be harmful too.
dialogue.uz: Texnologiya foydali, lekin zararli ham bo'lishi mumkin.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Balance is the answer.
dialogue.uz: Muvozanat — javob shu.

words.definition: machines and systems based on science
words.example: Technology changes very fast.

words.definition: a machine made for a particular purpose
words.example: This device charges in one hour.
words.exampleUz: Bu qurilma bir soatda quvvat oladi.

words.definition: the flat surface of a phone or computer
words.example: My screen is cracked.

words.definition: unable to stop doing something
words.example: Many teenagers are addicted to games.

words.definition: the right to keep your life private
words.example: Privacy online is important.

words.definition: to give part of something to others
words.example: Do not share your password.

words.definition: a system of connected people or computers
words.example: This social network has millions of users.
words.exampleUz: Bu ijtimoiy tarmoqda millionlab foydalanuvchi bor.

words.definition: the information shown on a website or app
words.example: She creates content about cooking.

words.definition: a written opinion about something online
words.example: His comment received many likes.

words.definition: causing damage or injury
words.example: Too much screen time is harmful.

description: Kelajak rejalari va maqsadlar.
story: Kelajak rejalari haqida suhbat. Bu yerda uch xil kelasi zamon farqi mashq qilinadi — o'zbek tilida bitta shakl bo'lgani uchun bu chalkash joy.
grammarFocus: Kelasi zamon: will / going to / present continuous

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: What are your plans after you graduate?
dialogue.uz: Diplom olganingizdan keyin rejangiz qanday?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I want to build a career in engineering.
dialogue.uz: Muhandislik sohasida karyera qurmoqchiman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Have you made a decision about the country?
dialogue.uz: Mamlakat haqida qaror qabul qildingizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Not yet. I am looking for an opportunity abroad.
dialogue.uz: Hali yo'q. Chet elda imkoniyat qidiryapman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: A foreign degree is a real challenge.
dialogue.uz: Chet el diplomi — haqiqiy sinov.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I know. But my goal is to improve my skills.
dialogue.uz: Bilaman. Lekin maqsadim — ko'nikmalarimni oshirish.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Can I give you some advice?
dialogue.uz: Sizga maslahat bersam bo'ladimi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Please do. I want to achieve something serious.
dialogue.uz: Marhamat. Men jiddiy narsaga erishmoqchiman.

words.definition: a qualification given by a university
words.example: She has a degree in economics.

words.definition: to finish your studies at a university
words.example: I will graduate next summer.

words.definition: the work you do over a long period of your life

words.definition: a chance to do something good

words.definition: to succeed in doing something after effort
words.example: She achieved all her goals.

words.definition: something you want to achieve
words.example: Set a clear goal for this year.
words.exampleUz: Bu yil uchun aniq maqsad qo'ying.

words.definition: to make something better
words.example: Reading will improve your vocabulary.

words.definition: something difficult that tests your ability
words.example: Learning a language is a challenge.

words.definition: an opinion about what someone should do
words.example: He gave me useful advice.

words.definition: a choice you make after thinking
words.example: It was a difficult decision.

description: Muammoni muloyim tarzda hal qilish.
story: Buyurtmangiz shikastlangan holda keldi. Muloyim, lekin qat'iy shikoyat qilish — chet elda ham, ishda ham eng kerakli ko'nikmalardan biri.
grammarFocus: Muloyim shikoyat: Would you mind…? / I'm afraid…

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: I want to complain about my order.
dialogue.uz: Buyurtmam haqida shikoyat qilmoqchiman.

dialogue.speaker: Support
dialogue.en: I apologise. What is the issue?
dialogue.uz: Uzr so'rayman. Muammo nimada?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: The package arrived damaged and two days late.
dialogue.uz: Paket shikastlangan holda va ikki kun kech keldi.

dialogue.speaker: Support
dialogue.en: I am sorry about the delay. Would you like a refund?
dialogue.uz: Kechikish uchun uzr. Pulni qaytarishimizni xohlaysizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Can you replace it instead?
dialogue.uz: Uning o'rniga almashtira olasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Support
dialogue.en: Of course. We will deliver a new one tomorrow.
dialogue.uz: Albatta. Ertaga yangisini yetkazib beramiz.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.en: Is there a guarantee?
dialogue.uz: Kafolat bormi?

dialogue.speaker: Support
dialogue.en: One year. Thank you for being a patient customer.
dialogue.uz: Bir yil. Sabrli mijoz bo'lganingiz uchun rahmat.

words.definition: to say that you are not satisfied
words.example: She complained about the noise.

words.definition: money returned to you
words.example: They gave me a full refund.

words.definition: to take goods to a place
words.example: They deliver orders every morning.
words.exampleUz: Ular buyurtmalarni har kuni ertalab yetkazib beradi.

words.definition: harmed or broken
words.example: The screen was damaged in transit.

words.definition: to put a new thing in place of an old one
words.example: We will replace the broken part.

words.definition: to say you are sorry
words.example: He apologised for the mistake.

words.definition: a situation when something happens later than planned
words.example: There was a long delay at the airport.

words.definition: a problem that needs attention
words.example: We solved the issue quickly.

words.definition: a person who buys goods or services
words.example: The customer asked for help.

words.definition: a promise to repair or replace a product
words.example: The laptop has a two-year guarantee.

description: Ijaraga uy ko'rish, narx va shartlarni kelishish.
story: Siz ijaraga kvartira qidiryapsiz va uy egasi bilan uchrashdingiz. Bu suhbatda Present Perfect (have seen — natija muhim) va Past Simple (saw yesterday — aniq vaqt) farqi yaqqol ko'rinadi.
grammarFocus: Present Perfect / Past Simple: Have you seen…? — I saw…

dialogue.speaker: Mr Brown
dialogue.en: Hello! Have you seen the flat before?
dialogue.uz: Salom! Kvartirani oldin ko'rganmisiz?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: No, I only saw the photos online yesterday. Is it still available?
dialogue.uz: Yo'q, kecha faqat internetdagi suratlarini ko'rdim. Hali bo'shmi?

dialogue.speaker: Mr Brown
dialogue.en: Yes. I am the landlord, and the last tenant left in May.
dialogue.uz: Ha. Men uy egasiman, oxirgi ijarachi may oyida chiqib ketdi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: It is very spacious. Is it furnished?
dialogue.uz: Juda keng ekan. Jihozlanganmi?

dialogue.speaker: Mr Brown
dialogue.en: Yes, and we have just repaired the heating.
dialogue.uz: Ha, isitish tizimini ham yaqinda ta'mirladik.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Great. How much is the rent?
dialogue.uz: Ajoyib. Ijara haqi qancha?

dialogue.speaker: Mr Brown
dialogue.en: Four hundred dollars a month, plus a deposit of one month.
dialogue.uz: Oyiga to'rt yuz dollar, ustiga bir oylik garov puli.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Can I stand on the balcony for a minute? The view is lovely.
dialogue.uz: Balkonda bir daqiqa tursam maylimi? Manzara juda chiroyli.

dialogue.speaker: Mr Brown
dialogue.en: Of course. If you like it, we can sign the contract today.
dialogue.uz: Albatta. Yoqsa, shartnomani bugun imzolashimiz mumkin.

words.definition: money you pay regularly to live in a place
words.example: The rent is due on the first day of the month.
words.exampleUz: Ijara haqi har oyning birinchi kuni to'lanadi.

words.definition: a person who rents a house or flat to other people
words.example: Our landlord lives on the ground floor.

words.definition: a person who pays rent to live in a place
words.example: The new tenant moved in last week.
words.exampleUz: Yangi ijarachi o'tgan hafta ko'chib keldi.

words.definition: money you pay at the start and get back later
words.example: You will get your deposit back when you leave.

words.definition: a written legal agreement
words.example: Please read the contract before you sign it.

words.definition: having furniture inside
words.example: We are looking for a furnished flat.

words.definition: a system that keeps a building warm
words.example: The heating does not work in winter.

words.definition: having a lot of space
words.example: The living room is bright and spacious.

words.definition: a small area outside an upstairs window
words.example: We drink tea on the balcony every evening.
words.exampleUz: Har kuni kechqurun balkonda choy ichamiz.

words.definition: free to use, buy or rent
