description: Taom tayyorlash bosqichlarini tushuntirish.
story: Buvingiz sizga palov pishirishni o'rgatyapti. Jarayonni tartib bilan aytib berish uchun first, then, after that, finally so'zlari ishlatiladi — inglizchada ko'rsatma berishning eng tabiiy yo'li.
grammarFocus: Ketma-ketlik: first, then, after that, finally

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: Grandma, can you teach me your plov recipe?
dialogue.uz: Buvi, menga palov retseptingizni o'rgatasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Grandma
dialogue.en: Of course. First, we need the right ingredients: meat, rice, onions and carrots.
dialogue.uz: Albatta. Avval to'g'ri masalliqlar kerak: go'sht, guruch, piyoz va sabzi.

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: What do we do first?
dialogue.uz: Avval nima qilamiz?

dialogue.speaker: Grandma
dialogue.en: First, heat the oil in a big pot. Then fry the onions until they are golden.
dialogue.uz: Avval katta qozonda yog'ni qizdiring. Keyin piyozni oltin rangga kirguncha qovuring.

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: And after that?
dialogue.uz: Undan keyin-chi?

dialogue.speaker: Grandma
dialogue.en: After that, add the meat and the carrots and cook them slowly.
dialogue.uz: Undan keyin go'sht va sabzini qo'shib, sekin pishiring.

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: When do we add the rice?
dialogue.uz: Guruchni qachon qo'shamiz?

dialogue.speaker: Grandma
dialogue.en: Finally, put the rice on top and pour boiling water over it.
dialogue.uz: Oxirida guruchni ustiga soling va ustidan qaynoq suv quying.

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: Can I taste it now?
dialogue.uz: Hozir tatib ko'rsam bo'ladimi?

dialogue.speaker: Grandma
dialogue.en: Not yet! Good plov needs patience.
dialogue.uz: Hali emas! Yaxshi palov sabr talab qiladi.

words.definition: instructions for cooking a dish
words.example: This is my mother’s favourite recipe.

words.definition: one of the foods used to make a dish
words.example: Rice is the main ingredient of plov.

words.definition: a round vegetable with a strong taste
words.example: Cut the onion into small pieces.

words.definition: a long orange vegetable
words.example: Yellow carrots make plov sweet.

words.definition: small white or brown grains that you cook and eat
words.example: We eat rice almost every day.
words.exampleUz: Biz deyarli har kuni guruch yeymiz.

words.definition: to cook food in hot oil
words.example: Fry the meat for ten minutes.

words.definition: to heat water until bubbles appear
words.example: Boil the water before you add the rice.

words.definition: a deep round container for cooking
words.example: My grandmother has a huge pot for plov.
words.exampleUz: Buvimning palov uchun katta qozoni bor.

words.definition: to make a liquid flow from a container
words.example: Pour the tea into the cups.

words.definition: to try a little food to see what it is like
words.example: Taste the soup and add some salt.
words.exampleUz: Sho'rvani tatib ko'ring va biroz tuz qo'shing.

description: O'tgan tadbirni jonli tasvirlab berish.
story: Do'stingiz shanba kungi to'y haqida so'rayapti. Voqea sodir bo'layotgan paytdagi manzarani tasvirlash uchun Past Continuous ishlatiladi: When we arrived, everyone was dancing.
grammarFocus: Past Continuous: was playing, were dancing

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: How was your cousin's wedding on Saturday?
dialogue.uz: Shanba kuni amakivachchangizning to'yi qanday o'tdi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Amazing! When we arrived, the musicians were playing and everyone was dancing.
dialogue.uz: Ajoyib! Biz kelganimizda musiqachilar chalayotgan, hamma raqsga tushayotgan edi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Was it crowded?
dialogue.uz: Odam ko'p edimi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Very. There were almost five hundred guests.
dialogue.uz: Juda. Deyarli besh yuzta mehmon bor edi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: What were the bride and groom wearing?
dialogue.uz: Kelin-kuyov nima kiygan edi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: The bride was wearing a white dress, and the groom was wearing a traditional coat.
dialogue.uz: Kelin oq ko'ylakda, kuyov esa milliy to'nda edi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Did you give them a gift?
dialogue.uz: Ularga sovg'a berdingizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes, and I congratulated them during the ceremony.
dialogue.uz: Ha, marosim paytida ularni tabrikladim ham.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: People here really know how to celebrate!
dialogue.uz: Bu yerda odamlar bayram qilishni juda yaxshi bilishadi!

words.definition: a ceremony where two people get married
words.example: Their wedding was in September.

words.definition: a woman on her wedding day
words.example: The bride looked very happy.

words.definition: a man on his wedding day
words.example: The groom arrived with his friends.

words.definition: a person who is invited to an event
words.example: Every guest received a small gift.
words.exampleUz: Har bir mehmonga kichik sovg'a berildi.

words.definition: to do something special for an important day
words.example: We celebrate my birthday at home.

words.definition: a formal event for a special occasion
words.example: The ceremony started at six o’clock.

words.definition: to move your body to music
words.example: She loves to dance at parties.
words.exampleUz: U bazmlarda raqsga tushishni yaxshi ko'radi.

words.definition: something you give to someone
words.example: Thank you for the lovely gift.

words.definition: full of people
words.example: The bazaar is always crowded on Sundays.

words.definition: to tell someone you are happy about their success
words.example: I want to congratulate you on your new job.

description: Reys, kechikish va aeroport muammolari haqida gapirish.
story: Reysingiz bekor qilindi va buni do'stingizga aytib beryapsiz. Davom etayotgan harakatni (was waiting) uni bo'lgan voqea (heard) bilan bog'lash uchun while va when ishlatiladi.
grammarFocus: Past Continuous + Past Simple: While I was waiting, they cancelled…

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: What happened? You look tired.
dialogue.uz: Nima bo'ldi? Charchagan ko'rinasiz.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: While I was waiting at the gate, they had to cancel my flight.
dialogue.uz: Chiqish eshigi oldida kutayotganimda, reysimni bekor qilishga majbur bo'lishdi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Oh no! Did they make an announcement?
dialogue.uz: Voy! E'lon qilishdimi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes. When I heard the announcement, I was drinking coffee near the departure board.
dialogue.uz: Ha. E'lonni eshitganimda uchish jadvali yonida qahva ichayotgan edim.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: So what did the other passengers do?
dialogue.uz: Boshqa yo'lovchilar nima qilishdi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Everyone went back through security to get a new boarding pass.
dialogue.uz: Hamma yangi chiqish taloni olish uchun xavfsizlik nazoratidan qayta o'tdi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: And your suitcase?
dialogue.uz: Chamadoningiz-chi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: It was already on the plane! It landed in Istanbul without me.
dialogue.uz: U allaqachon samolyotda edi! Mensiz Istanbulga qo'ndi.

words.definition: a journey in a plane
words.example: Our flight leaves at nine.

words.definition: the place where you get on a plane
words.example: Please go to gate twelve.
words.exampleUz: Iltimos, o'n ikkinchi chiqish eshigiga boring.

words.definition: the act of getting on a plane
words.example: Boarding starts thirty minutes before the flight.
words.exampleUz: Samolyotga chiqish reysdan o'ttiz daqiqa oldin boshlanadi.

words.definition: the act of leaving a place
words.example: Check the departure time on your ticket.

words.definition: the place where your bags are checked
words.example: The line at security was very long.
words.exampleUz: Xavfsizlik nazoratidagi navbat juda uzun edi.

words.definition: a person travelling in a vehicle but not driving it
words.example: Every passenger must show a passport.
words.exampleUz: Har bir yo'lovchi pasport ko'rsatishi shart.

words.definition: a large bag for clothes when you travel
words.example: My suitcase is too heavy.

words.definition: an official public message
words.example: Listen to the announcement carefully.

words.definition: to come down to the ground after flying
words.example: The plane will land in two hours.

words.definition: to decide that something will not happen
words.example: They may cancel the trip because of snow.
words.exampleUz: Qor sababli safarni bekor qilishlari mumkin.

description: Safar rejasini tuzish va ehtimoliy vaziyatlarni muhokama qilish.
story: Do'stingiz bilan Chimyon tog'lariga mashinada borishni rejalashtiryapsiz. Real ehtimoliy vaziyatlar haqida gapirish uchun birinchi shart gap ishlatiladi: If + present, will + fe'l.
grammarFocus: 1-shart gap: If we leave at seven, we will…

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: If we leave at seven, we will reach the mountains before lunch.
dialogue.uz: Soat yettida chiqsak, tushlikkacha tog'larga yetamiz.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Which route are we taking?
dialogue.uz: Qaysi yo'nalish bo'yicha boramiz?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: The highway to Chimgan. The scenery is beautiful after the city.
dialogue.uz: Chimyonga katta yo'l orqali. Shahardan keyin manzara juda go'zal.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Do we have enough fuel?
dialogue.uz: Yoqilg'i yetarlimi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Not yet. If we stop at the next station, I will fill the tank.
dialogue.uz: Hali yo'q. Keyingi shoxobchada to'xtasak, bakni to'ldiraman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Please don't drive at high speed. The road is narrow there.
dialogue.uz: Iltimos, katta tezlikda haydamang. U yerda yo'l tor.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Don't worry. And if we get stuck, we have a spare tyre.
dialogue.uz: Xavotir olmang. Yo'lda qolib ketsak, zaxira g'ildiragimiz bor.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: What will we do when we reach our destination?
dialogue.uz: Manzilga yetib borganimizda nima qilamiz?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: We will have a picnic by the river.
dialogue.uz: Daryo bo'yida piknik qilamiz.

words.definition: the way you go from one place to another
words.example: This route is shorter but busier.

words.definition: petrol, gas or other material that makes an engine work
words.example: Fuel is getting more expensive.

words.definition: a big road between cities
words.example: The new highway connects the two cities.
words.exampleUz: Yangi katta yo'l ikki shaharni bog'laydi.

words.definition: a very high hill
words.example: We climbed the mountain in the morning.

words.definition: the natural things you see around you, like hills and trees
words.example: The scenery in Fergana Valley is wonderful.

words.definition: how fast something moves
words.example: The speed limit here is sixty.

words.definition: the place you are travelling to
words.example: Samarkand is a popular destination.

words.definition: a meal that you eat outside
words.example: Let us have a picnic in the park.

words.definition: unable to move
words.example: We were stuck in traffic for an hour.

words.definition: extra, kept in case you need it
words.example: Always keep a spare key.

description: Buyurtma, yetkazib berish va qaytarish haqida gaplashish.
story: Internetdan narsa buyurtma qildingiz va uni kutyapsiz. Hozirgi holat haqida gapirganda just (hozirgina), already (allaqachon) va yet (hali) Present Perfect bilan birga keladi.
grammarFocus: Present Perfect: just / already / yet

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: Has your parcel arrived yet?
dialogue.uz: Posilkangiz hali keldimi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Not yet. I have just checked the tracking page.
dialogue.uz: Hali yo'q. Hozirgina kuzatish sahifasini tekshirdim.

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: When did you order it?
dialogue.uz: Qachon buyurtma bergandingiz?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: On Monday. They have already confirmed the delivery for today.
dialogue.uz: Dushanba kuni. Yetkazib berishni bugunga allaqachon tasdiqlashgan.

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: Did you get a discount?
dialogue.uz: Chegirma oldingizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes, twenty percent. I read the reviews before I paid.
dialogue.uz: Ha, yigirma foiz. To'lashdan oldin sharhlarni o'qib chiqdim.

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: What if the item is the wrong size?
dialogue.uz: Mahsulot o'lchami to'g'ri kelmasa-chi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Then I can return it within fourteen days. I just need to keep the receipt.
dialogue.uz: Unda o'n to'rt kun ichida qaytarishim mumkin. Faqat chekni saqlashim kerak.

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: Look — I think the courier has just arrived!
dialogue.uz: Qarang — kuryer hozirgina keldi shekilli!

words.definition: something wrapped in paper and sent by post
words.example: I sent a parcel to my sister.

words.definition: a person who delivers packages
words.example: The courier called me from the gate.
words.exampleUz: Kuryer menga darvoza oldidan qo'ng'iroq qildi.

words.definition: bringing goods to a person or place
words.example: Delivery is free for orders over fifty dollars.
words.exampleUz: Ellik dollardan oshgan buyurtmalar uchun yetkazib berish bepul.

words.definition: a lower price than usual
words.example: Students get a ten percent discount.

words.definition: a paper that shows you have paid
words.example: Keep the receipt in case you need to return it.
words.exampleUz: Qaytarish kerak bo'lib qolsa, chekni saqlab qo'ying.

words.definition: an opinion about a product or service
words.example: The phone has very good reviews.
words.exampleUz: Bu telefon haqida sharhlar juda yaxshi.

words.definition: to follow where something is
words.example: You can track your order online.

words.definition: to give or send something back
words.example: I want to return these shoes.

words.definition: to say that something is true or will happen
words.example: Please confirm your address.

words.definition: one thing in a list or group
words.example: There are three items in my basket.

description: Odamlar va joylarni aniqlab tasvirlash.
story: Yangi qo'shningizga mahallani tanishtiryapsiz. Odam yoki narsani aniqlashtirish uchun who (odam), which (narsa) va that (ikkalasi) ishlatiladi — o'zbek tilidagi "-gan", "-digan" qo'shimchalariga mos keladi.
grammarFocus: Aniqlovchi ergash gap: who / which / that

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Who is the man who lives next door?
dialogue.uz: Qo'shni uyda yashaydigan kishi kim?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: That's Rustam aka. He is the neighbour who helps everyone.
dialogue.uz: Bu Rustam aka. U hammaga yordam beradigan qo'shni.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: He seems very generous.
dialogue.uz: U juda saxiy ko'rinadi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: He is. He always lends me the tools that I need to repair things.
dialogue.uz: Shunday. Narsalarni ta'mirlashim uchun kerak bo'lgan asboblarni doim qarzga berib turadi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Can I borrow something from him too?
dialogue.uz: Men ham undan biror narsa olib tursam bo'ladimi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Sure. Our community is small, so people trust each other.
dialogue.uz: Albatta. Mahallamiz kichik, shuning uchun odamlar bir-biriga ishonadi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Is the street noisy at night?
dialogue.uz: Kechasi ko'cha shovqinli bo'ladimi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: No. Most people here are elderly and go to bed early.
dialogue.uz: Yo'q. Bu yerdagi ko'pchilik keksa odamlar va erta yotishadi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: And the garden which is behind the building — whose is it?
dialogue.uz: Bino ortidagi bog'-chi — kimniki?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: It belongs to all of us. We grow tomatoes there in summer.
dialogue.uz: Hammamizniki. Yozda u yerda pomidor o'stiramiz.

words.definition: a person who lives near you
words.example: Our neighbour brought us some bread.

words.definition: the people who live in one area
words.example: The whole community helped after the flood.
words.exampleUz: Toshqindan keyin butun mahalla yordam berdi.

words.definition: to give something that will be returned later
words.example: Can you lend me your pen?

words.definition: to take something that you will give back later
words.example: I need to borrow some money.

words.definition: making a lot of loud sounds
words.example: The children are very noisy today.

words.definition: old (a polite word)
words.example: She takes care of her elderly parents.

words.definition: land near a house where flowers and vegetables grow
words.example: My father works in the garden every morning.

words.definition: to fix something that is broken
words.example: Who can repair my washing machine?
words.exampleUz: Kir yuvish mashinamni kim ta'mirlay oladi?

words.definition: happy to give money, time or help
words.example: It was generous of you to help us.

words.definition: to believe that someone is honest
words.example: I trust my best friend completely.

description: Belgilarni tushuntirish va dori haqida so'rash.
story: Shamollab qoldingiz va dorixonaga keldingiz. Majburiyat (must, have to) va majburiyat yo'qligi (don't have to — shart emas) farqini bilish bu yerda muhim: mustn't esa "mumkin emas" degani.
grammarFocus: must / have to / don't have to

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Good afternoon. I have a bad cough and a sore throat.
dialogue.uz: Xayrli kun. Qattiq yo'talim bor va tomog'im og'riyapti.

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.en: How long have you had these symptoms?
dialogue.uz: Bu belgilar qachondan beri bor?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: About three days. Do I have to get a prescription?
dialogue.uz: Taxminan uch kun. Retsept olishim shartmi?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.en: No, you don't have to. This syrup is sold without one. Are you allergic to anything?
dialogue.uz: Yo'q, shart emas. Bu sirop retseptsiz sotiladi. Biror narsaga allergiyangiz bormi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Not that I know. How should I take it?
dialogue.uz: Bilishimcha yo'q. Uni qanday ichishim kerak?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.en: The dose is one spoon three times a day. You must not take more.
dialogue.uz: Dozasi kuniga uch mahal bir qoshiq. Undan ko'p ichmaslik kerak.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: And these tablets for my throat?
dialogue.uz: Tomog'im uchun bu tabletkalar-chi?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.en: Don't swallow them. You have to keep them in your mouth until they melt.
dialogue.uz: Ularni yutmang. Erib ketguncha og'zingizda ushlab turishingiz kerak.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Thank you. The pharmacist in this pharmacy is always so helpful.
dialogue.uz: Rahmat. Bu dorixonadagi farmatsevt doim juda yordam beradi.

words.definition: a shop where you can buy medicine
words.example: Is there a pharmacy near here?

words.definition: a person whose job is to prepare and sell medicine
words.example: Ask the pharmacist about the side effects.

words.definition: a paper from a doctor that allows you to get medicine
words.example: You need a prescription for these antibiotics.

words.definition: a small solid piece of medicine
words.example: Take one tablet after dinner.
words.exampleUz: Kechki ovqatdan keyin bitta tabletka iching.

words.definition: the act of pushing air out of your throat with a sudden noise
words.example: My cough is worse at night.

words.definition: becoming ill when you eat or touch something
words.example: I am allergic to cats.

words.definition: the amount of medicine you take at one time
words.example: Do not take more than the normal dose.

words.definition: a sign that you are ill
words.example: A high temperature is a common symptom of flu.
words.exampleUz: Yuqori harorat — grippning keng tarqalgan belgisi.

words.definition: to make food or drink go down your throat
words.example: It hurts when I swallow.

words.definition: the inside of your neck
words.example: Drink warm tea for a sore throat.

description: Ixtiyoriy yordam va jamoat ishlari haqida gapirish.
story: Do'stingiz dam olish kunlari ko'ngilli bo'lib ishlaydi. Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin -ing (enjoy, finish), boshqalaridan keyin to + fe'l (decide, want) keladi — buni yodlab olish kerak.
grammarFocus: Fe'l + -ing / to + fe'l: enjoy helping, decide to join

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: What do you usually do on Sundays?
dialogue.uz: Yakshanba kunlari odatda nima qilasiz?

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: I volunteer at an animal shelter. I enjoy helping there.
dialogue.uz: Hayvonlar boshpanasida ko'ngilli bo'lib ishlayman. U yerda yordam berishni yoqtiraman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: That sounds rewarding. How did you start?
dialogue.uz: Bu juda mazmunli ekan. Qanday boshladingiz?

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: A charity asked for help, so I decided to join them.
dialogue.uz: Bir xayriya tashkiloti yordam so'radi, men ularga qo'shilishga qaror qildim.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: What kind of work do you do?
dialogue.uz: Qanday ishlar qilasiz?

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: We collect food and organise events to find homes for the animals.
dialogue.uz: Oziq-ovqat yig'amiz va hayvonlarga uy topish uchun tadbirlar tashkil qilamiz.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Can people donate money?
dialogue.uz: Odamlar pul xayriya qilishi mumkinmi?

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: Yes, but we also need people who want to support old people who feel lonely.
dialogue.uz: Ha, lekin yolg'izlik his qiladigan keksalarni qo'llab-quvvatlashni istaydigan odamlar ham kerak.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: I'd love to try it next Sunday.
dialogue.uz: Keyingi yakshanba sinab ko'rmoqchiman.

words.definition: to work without being paid in order to help
words.example: She volunteers at the hospital on Fridays.
words.exampleUz: U juma kunlari kasalxonada ko'ngilli bo'lib ishlaydi.

words.definition: an organisation that helps people in need
words.example: We gave our old clothes to charity.

words.definition: to give money or things to help others
words.example: Many people donate blood every year.
words.exampleUz: Ko'p odamlar har yili qon topshiradi.

words.definition: to plan and arrange an event
words.example: Who will organise the party?

words.definition: to bring things together from different places
words.example: We collect books for the village school.

words.definition: to help someone, especially in a difficult time
words.example: My family always supports me.

words.definition: a place that protects people or animals
words.example: The dog came from a shelter.

words.definition: a planned public occasion
words.example: The event starts at five.

words.definition: giving you satisfaction
words.example: Teaching children is very rewarding.

words.definition: sad because you have no friends or company
words.example: He felt lonely in the new city.
words.exampleUz: U yangi shaharda o'zini yolg'iz his qildi.

description: Didingiz haqida gapirish va tavsiya berish.
story: Do'stingiz bilan film va seriallarni muhokama qilyapsiz. Afzal ko'rishni ifodalashning ikki yo'li bor: I prefer films to series va I'd rather watch a film.
grammarFocus: prefer … to … / would rather …

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Have you watched the new Turkish series?
dialogue.uz: Yangi turk serialini ko'rdingizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: Only the first episode. Honestly, I prefer films to series.
dialogue.uz: Faqat birinchi qismini. Rostini aytsam, men seriallardan ko'ra filmlarni afzal ko'raman.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Why? The plot is really exciting.
dialogue.uz: Nega? Syujeti juda qiziqarli.

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: I'd rather watch one good film than forty episodes.
dialogue.uz: Qirqta qismdan ko'ra bitta yaxshi film ko'rganim ma'qul.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Fair enough. What genre do you like?
dialogue.uz: Tushunarli. Qaysi janrni yoqtirasiz?

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: Comedies. And I always watch with English subtitles.
dialogue.uz: Komediyalarni. Va doim inglizcha subtitr bilan ko'raman.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Can you recommend a good one?
dialogue.uz: Yaxshisini tavsiya qila olasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: Yes! The director is young, but the actors are brilliant.
dialogue.uz: Ha! Rejissyori yosh, lekin aktyorlari zo'r.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Does it have a happy ending?
dialogue.uz: Oxiri baxtli tugaydimi?

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: I won't tell you. But the last scene made me cry.
dialogue.uz: Aytmayman. Lekin oxirgi sahna meni yig'latdi.

words.definition: a set of TV programmes with the same characters
words.example: This series has five seasons.

words.definition: one part of a TV series
words.example: I watched three episodes last night.

words.definition: a person who performs in films or plays
words.example: He is my favourite actor.

words.definition: the person who controls how a film is made
words.example: The director won an award for this film.
words.exampleUz: Rejissyor bu film uchun mukofot oldi.

words.definition: the story of a film or book
words.example: The plot is simple but interesting.

words.definition: a part of a film where the action happens in one place
words.example: The final scene was very sad.

words.definition: a type of film, music or book
words.example: Horror is not my favourite genre.

words.definition: words on the screen that translate what people say
words.example: Can you turn on the subtitles?

words.definition: to say that something is good and someone should try it
words.example: I recommend this restaurant.

words.definition: the last part of a story
words.example: I did not expect that ending.

description: Xarajatlar, byudjet va jamg'arma haqida gapirish.
story: Oy o'rtasida pulingiz tugab qoldi va do'stingizdan maslahat so'rayapsiz. too (haddan ortiq) va enough (yetarli) — pul haqidagi gaplarda eng ko'p ishlatiladigan so'zlar.
grammarFocus: too / enough: too much, not enough money

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: You look worried. What's wrong?
dialogue.uz: Xavotirli ko'rinasiz. Nima bo'ldi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: My wallet is almost empty, and it's only the tenth of the month.
dialogue.uz: Hamyonim deyarli bo'sh, vaholanki oyning faqat o'ninchi kuni.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Do you have a budget?
dialogue.uz: Byudjetingiz bormi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Not really. My income is enough, but I spend too much on eating out.
dialogue.uz: Unchalik emas. Daromadim yetarli, lekin tashqarida ovqatlanishga juda ko'p sarflayman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Write down every expense for a month. You will be surprised.
dialogue.uz: Bir oy davomida har bir xarajatni yozib boring. Hayron qolasiz.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Good idea. I also want a laptop, but I can't afford it yet.
dialogue.uz: Yaxshi fikr. Noutbuk ham olmoqchiman, lekin hozircha qurbim yetmaydi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Then put a little into savings every week.
dialogue.uz: Unda har hafta jamg'armaga ozgina qo'yib boring.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Should I withdraw cash or pay by card?
dialogue.uz: Naqd pul yechib olaymi yoki karta bilan to'layinmi?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Cash helps. When you see the money leave your hand, you spend less. And always look for a bargain!
dialogue.uz: Naqd yordam beradi. Pul qo'lingizdan ketayotganini ko'rsangiz, kamroq sarflaysiz. Doim qulay narxni qidiring!

words.definition: a plan for how to spend money
words.example: We are on a tight budget this month.

words.definition: to use money to buy things
words.example: How much do you spend on food?

words.definition: to have enough money to pay for something
words.example: We cannot afford a new car.

words.definition: money that you have saved
words.example: She used her savings to start a course.
words.exampleUz: U kurs boshlash uchun jamg'armasini ishlatdi.

words.definition: something bought for less than its usual price
words.example: This jacket was a real bargain.

words.definition: a small case for money and cards
words.example: I left my wallet at home.

words.definition: money in coins or notes
words.example: Do you accept cash?

words.definition: money that you earn
words.example: Their monthly income has grown.

words.definition: money that you spend on something
words.example: Rent is our biggest expense.

words.definition: to take money out of a bank account
words.example: I need to withdraw some money from the ATM.
words.exampleUz: Bankomatdan biroz pul yechib olishim kerak.

description: Reja, xavf va maqsadlar haqida gapirish.
story: Do'stingiz nonvoyxona ochmoqchi. Kelajak rejalari haqida gapirganda plan to, hope to, intend to, expect to kabi tuzilmalar will'dan ko'ra aniqroq va tabiiyroq eshitiladi.
grammarFocus: plan to / hope to / intend to + fe'l

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I heard you plan to open a bakery!
dialogue.uz: Nonvoyxona ochmoqchi ekaningizni eshitdim!

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: Yes! I hope to launch it next spring. It will be my own business.
dialogue.uz: Ha! Uni kelasi bahorda ishga tushirishni umid qilaman. Bu mening shaxsiy biznesim bo'ladi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: That's a big risk. Are you ready?
dialogue.uz: Bu katta tavakkal. Tayyormisiz?

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: I think so. I have found a good supplier of flour and sugar.
dialogue.uz: Menimcha, ha. Un va shakarning yaxshi yetkazib beruvchisini topdim.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: What will your main product be?
dialogue.uz: Asosiy mahsulotingiz nima bo'ladi?

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: Cakes and fresh bread. I intend to advertise on Instagram first.
dialogue.uz: Tortlar va yangi non. Avval Instagramda reklama qilmoqchiman.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: When do you expect to make a profit?
dialogue.uz: Qachon foyda ko'rishni kutyapsiz?

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: Maybe after a year. The owner of the shop next door says loyal customers are the key.
dialogue.uz: Balki bir yildan keyin. Qo'shni do'kon egasi sodiq mijozlar asosiy omil deydi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I'm sure you'll succeed.
dialogue.uz: Ishonchim komil, muvaffaqiyat qozonasiz.

words.definition: the activity of buying and selling to make money
words.example: He runs a small family business.

words.definition: money you make after paying all costs
words.example: The shop made a good profit this year.
words.exampleUz: Do'kon bu yil yaxshi foyda ko'rdi.

words.definition: something that is made to be sold
words.example: This is our most popular product.

words.definition: to start something new, like a product or company
words.example: The company will launch a new app in May.
words.exampleUz: Kompaniya mayda yangi ilovani ishga tushiradi.

words.definition: to tell people about a product so that they buy it
words.example: Small shops often advertise on social media.
words.exampleUz: Kichik do'konlar ko'pincha ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda reklama qiladi.

words.definition: a company that provides goods to another company
words.example: We changed our supplier last month.

words.definition: a person who owns something
words.example: The owner of the café is very friendly.

words.definition: always supporting someone or something
words.example: Loyal customers come back again and again.

words.definition: to achieve what you wanted
words.example: If you work hard, you will succeed.

words.definition: the possibility that something bad will happen
words.example: Starting a business is always a risk.

description: Kechikish sababini ketma-ket voqealar bilan tushuntirish.
story: Ishga kechikdingiz va sababini tushuntiryapsiz. O'tmishdagi ikki voqeadan qaysi biri oldinroq bo'lganini ko'rsatish uchun Past Perfect (had left, had changed) ishlatiladi.
grammarFocus: Past Perfect: the train had already left

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Why were you late for work today?
dialogue.uz: Bugun ishga nega kechikdingiz?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: When I got to the platform, the train had already left.
dialogue.uz: Platformaga yetib borganimda poyezd allaqachon ketib qolgan edi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Didn't you check the timetable?
dialogue.uz: Jadvalni tekshirmaganmidingiz?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I had checked it, but they had changed it the day before because of a breakdown.
dialogue.uz: Tekshirgandim, lekin bir kun oldin buzilish sababli uni o'zgartirishgan ekan.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: That's annoying. How long is your commute?
dialogue.uz: Bu jahlni chiqaradi. Ishga borib-kelishingiz qancha vaqt oladi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Usually forty minutes on the underground, with one transfer.
dialogue.uz: Odatda metroda qirq daqiqa, bitta almashish bilan.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: And during the rush hour?
dialogue.uz: Tig'iz soatlarda-chi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Much longer. Today there was a long queue even to buy a ticket.
dialogue.uz: Ancha uzoqroq. Bugun hatto chipta olish uchun ham uzun navbat bor edi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Has the fare gone up too?
dialogue.uz: Yo'l haqi ham oshdimi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes. The whole journey costs more and takes longer!
dialogue.uz: Ha. Butun yo'l qimmatroq va uzoqroq bo'lib qoldi!

words.definition: the place at a station where you get on a train
words.example: The train leaves from platform three.

words.definition: travelling from one place to another
words.example: The journey to Bukhara takes four hours.
words.exampleUz: Buxoroga yo'l to'rt soat davom etadi.

words.definition: the money you pay to travel
words.example: The bus fare is two thousand sums.
words.exampleUz: Avtobus yo'l haqi ikki ming so'm.

words.definition: changing from one bus, train or plane to another
words.example: There is a short transfer in Moscow.

words.definition: a situation when many people hurry
words.example: Avoid the morning rush if you can.

words.definition: a railway system under a city
words.example: The underground is the fastest way to travel.

words.definition: a situation when a machine stops working
words.example: We had a breakdown on the way home.

words.definition: the regular journey between home and work
words.example: My daily commute takes an hour.
words.exampleUz: Har kungi ishga qatnashim bir soat oladi.

words.definition: a line of people waiting
words.example: There was a long queue at the bank.

words.definition: a list of times when buses or trains leave
words.example: Check the timetable before you go.

description: O'yinni muhokama qilish va taqqoslash.
story: Kechagi final o'yinini muhokama qilyapsiz. Eng yaxshi va eng yomon lahzalarni ta'kidlash uchun orttirma daraja (the strongest, the most exciting) ishlatiladi.
grammarFocus: Orttirma daraja: the most exciting, the best, the worst

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Did you watch the final? It was the most exciting match of the year!
dialogue.uz: Finalni ko'rdingizmi? Bu yilning eng hayajonli o'yini edi!

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Yes! Our team beat the strongest opponent in Asia.
dialogue.uz: Ha! Jamoamiz Osiyodagi eng kuchli raqibni yutdi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: The score was two–one. The fans went crazy.
dialogue.uz: Hisob ikki–bir edi. Muxlislar aqldan ozishdi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Our goalkeeper was the best player on the field.
dialogue.uz: Darvozabonimiz maydondagi eng yaxshi o'yinchi edi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: But the referee made the worst decision of the game in the first half.
dialogue.uz: Lekin hakam birinchi bo'limda o'yinning eng yomon qarorini qabul qildi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: True. The coach was really angry.
dialogue.uz: To'g'ri. Murabbiyning juda jahli chiqdi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Now we are champions! It's the biggest trophy in our history.
dialogue.uz: Endi biz chempionmiz! Bu tariximizdagi eng katta kubok.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: And our striker broke a record — six goals in the competition.
dialogue.uz: Hujumchimiz esa rekord yangiladi — musobaqada oltita gol.

words.definition: an event where people try to win
words.example: She won a singing competition.

words.definition: the winner of a competition
words.example: He became world champion at twenty.
words.exampleUz: U yigirma yoshida jahon chempioni bo'ldi.

words.definition: a prize, often a silver cup, for winning
words.example: The captain lifted the trophy.

words.definition: a person who likes a team or famous person very much
words.example: I am a big fan of Pakhtakor.

words.definition: the person who controls a game
words.example: The referee stopped the match.

words.definition: a person who trains a team or athlete
words.example: Our coach is very strict.

words.definition: to win against someone
words.example: We beat them three–nil.

words.definition: the best result ever achieved
words.example: She set a new national record.

words.definition: a person or team you play against
words.example: Never underestimate your opponent.

words.definition: the number of points or goals in a game
words.example: What was the final score?

description: Tarixiy joylar haqida so'rash va gapirib berish.
story: Registonda sayyohga ekskursiya o'tkazyapsiz. Tarixiy obidalar haqida gapirganda kim qurgani emas, nima qilingani muhim — shuning uchun Past Passive (was built, were restored) ishlatiladi.
grammarFocus: O'tgan zamon majhul nisbati: was built, were restored

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.en: This square is incredible. When was it built?
dialogue.uz: Bu maydon ajoyib. U qachon qurilgan?

dialogue.speaker: Guide
dialogue.en: The Registan was created between the fifteenth and the seventeenth centuries.
dialogue.uz: Registon XV–XVII asrlar oralig'ida bunyod etilgan.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.en: Who was it built for?
dialogue.uz: U kim uchun qurilgan?

dialogue.speaker: Guide
dialogue.en: The first madrasa was ordered by Ulugbek, a ruler and a great scientist.
dialogue.uz: Birinchi madrasani hukmdor va buyuk olim Ulug'bek qurdirgan.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.en: Samarkand was the capital of an empire, wasn't it?
dialogue.uz: Samarqand imperiya poytaxti bo'lgan, shunday emasmi?

dialogue.speaker: Guide
dialogue.en: Yes, the empire of Amir Temur. It is one of the most ancient cities in the world.
dialogue.uz: Ha, Amir Temur imperiyasining. U dunyodagi eng qadimiy shaharlardan biri.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.en: The blue dome over there is amazing. Were the tiles made by hand?
dialogue.uz: Anavi ko'k gumbaz hayratlanarli. Koshinlar qo'lda yasalganmi?

dialogue.speaker: Guide
dialogue.en: Yes. Many monuments were damaged by earthquakes, but they were restored in the last century.
dialogue.uz: Ha. Ko'plab obidalar zilzilalardan zarar ko'rgan, lekin o'tgan asrda qayta tiklangan.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.en: Do we know the names of the architects?
dialogue.uz: Me'morlarning ismlari ma'lummi?

dialogue.speaker: Guide
dialogue.en: Some of them. Today the city is protected as world heritage.
dialogue.uz: Ba'zilariniki. Bugun shahar jahon merosi sifatida muhofaza qilinadi.

words.definition: very old, from a long time ago
words.example: Bukhara is an ancient city.

words.definition: a group of countries ruled by one leader
words.example: The empire was very large.

words.definition: a period of one hundred years
words.example: The mosque was built in the fourteenth century.

words.definition: an old building or statue that is important in history
words.example: The city has many famous monuments.

words.definition: a person who controls a country
words.example: He was a wise ruler.

words.definition: a person who designs buildings
words.example: The architect designed a modern library.

words.definition: to repair something old so it looks like new
words.example: They want to restore the old theatre.

words.definition: history and traditions passed from the past
words.example: We must protect our cultural heritage.

words.definition: a round roof on a building
words.example: The dome is covered with blue tiles.

words.definition: a flat square piece used to cover walls or floors
words.example: Each tile was painted by hand.

description: O'qish tajribasi va yutuqlar haqida gapirish.
story: Kimdir ingliz tilingizni maqtadi va qancha vaqtdan beri o'rganayotganingizni so'radi. Hozirgacha davom etayotgan jarayon uchun Present Perfect Continuous ishlatiladi: I have been learning…
grammarFocus: Present Perfect Continuous: I have been studying for two years

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Your English is really good! How long have you been learning it?
dialogue.uz: Ingliz tilingiz juda yaxshi! Qancha vaqtdan beri o'rganyapsiz?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I have been studying it for two years, but I'm not fluent yet.
dialogue.uz: Ikki yildan beri o'qiyapman, lekin hali ravon emasman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: What has been the hardest part?
dialogue.uz: Eng qiyini nima bo'ldi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Grammar was easy. But I still can't pronounce some words, like 'thought'.
dialogue.uz: Grammatika oson edi. Lekin ba'zi so'zlarni, masalan 'thought'ni hali to'g'ri talaffuz qila olmayman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Your accent is fine. Every learner makes mistakes.
dialogue.uz: Talaffuzingiz yaxshi. Har bir o'rganuvchi xato qiladi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I have been practising with a native speaker online every week.
dialogue.uz: Har hafta internetda ona tili ingliz tili bo'lgan odam bilan mashq qilyapman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: That's the best way. Do you translate everything in your head?
dialogue.uz: Bu eng yaxshi yo'l. Hamma narsani miyangizda tarjima qilasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Less and less. My vocabulary has been growing, so I think in English more often.
dialogue.uz: Tobora kamroq. So'z boyligim o'sib boryapti, shuning uchun ko'proq inglizcha o'ylayman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: That's real progress!
dialogue.uz: Bu haqiqiy yutuq!

words.definition: able to speak a language easily and well
words.example: She is fluent in three languages.

words.definition: the way someone pronounces words
words.example: He speaks with a British accent.

words.definition: the rules of a language
words.example: English grammar is not very hard.
words.exampleUz: Ingliz tili grammatikasi unchalik qiyin emas.

words.definition: all the words that a person knows
words.example: Reading helps you build your vocabulary.
words.exampleUz: O'qish so'z boyligini oshirishga yordam beradi.

words.definition: to say a word in a particular way
words.example: How do you pronounce this word?

words.definition: something that is not correct
words.example: Everyone makes mistakes.

words.definition: connected with the place where you were born
words.example: Uzbek is my native language.

words.definition: to change words into another language
words.example: Can you translate this letter for me?
words.exampleUz: Bu xatni men uchun tarjima qila olasizmi?

words.definition: to do something many times to improve
words.example: I practise speaking every morning.

words.definition: the process of getting better
words.example: You have made great progress this year.

description: Kim nima deganini boshqaga aytib berish.
story: Do'stingiz bilan urishib qoldingiz va bo'lgan voqeani boshqa do'stingizga aytib beryapsiz. Birovning gapini yetkazishda zamon bir qadam orqaga suriladi: "I told" → she said that I had told.
grammarFocus: Ko'chirma gap: She said that I had told…

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: You and Dilnoza aren't talking. Did you argue?
dialogue.uz: Dilnoza bilan gaplashmayapsiz. Janjallashdingizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: Yes. She said that I had told her secret to everyone.
dialogue.uz: Ha. U men uning sirini hammaga aytib qo'yganman, dedi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Had you?
dialogue.uz: Rostdan aytganmidingiz?

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: No! I only mentioned it to my sister. And I promised her I wouldn't tell anyone else.
dialogue.uz: Yo'q! Faqat singlimga aytib o'tgandim. Unga boshqa hech kimga aytmayman deb va'da ham bergandim.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: So it was a misunderstanding.
dialogue.uz: Demak, bu tushunmovchilik ekan.

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: Maybe. But someone told her that I was jealous of her new job. That's just gossip.
dialogue.uz: Balki. Lekin kimdir unga men uning yangi ishiga hasad qilyapman, debdi. Bu shunchaki g'iybat.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Your friendship is ten years old. Talk to her.
dialogue.uz: Do'stligingizga o'n yil bo'ldi. U bilan gaplashing.

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: You're right. I can always rely on her, and I hope she can forgive me.
dialogue.uz: Haqsiz. Men unga doim tayanishim mumkin, u meni kechirar degan umiddaman.

words.definition: a relationship between friends
words.example: Their friendship began at school.

words.definition: to speak angrily to someone because you disagree
words.example: My brothers argue about football.

words.definition: a situation when someone does not understand correctly
words.example: It was just a small misunderstanding.

words.definition: something that other people must not know
words.example: Can you keep a secret?

words.definition: to say that you will certainly do something
words.example: I promise to call you tomorrow.
words.exampleUz: Ertaga sizga qo'ng'iroq qilishga va'da beraman.

words.definition: to trust someone to help you
words.example: You can always rely on me.

words.definition: unhappy because someone has something you want
words.example: He was jealous of his brother’s new car.
words.exampleUz: U akasining yangi mashinasiga hasad qildi.

words.definition: talk about other people’s private lives
words.example: Do not listen to gossip.

words.definition: to stop being angry with someone
words.example: Please forgive me for being late.

words.definition: to speak about something briefly
words.example: She did not mention her new job.

description: Texnologiya xavflari haqida taxmin qilish.
story: Telefoningiz g'alati ishlayapti va do'stingiz sababini taxmin qilyapti. Aniq bilmagan narsa haqida gapirganda might, may va could ishlatiladi — "bo'lishi mumkin".
grammarFocus: Ehtimollik: might / may / could

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: My battery dies so fast now. I have to charge it three times a day.
dialogue.uz: Endi batareyam juda tez tugaydi. Kuniga uch marta quvvatlashim kerak.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: It might be an app that runs all the time. Check your settings.
dialogue.uz: Doim ishlab turadigan biror ilova bo'lishi mumkin. Sozlamalarni tekshiring.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: This game asks for permission to use my camera and my location. Why?
dialogue.uz: Bu o'yin kamera va joylashuvimdan foydalanishga ruxsat so'rayapti. Nega?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: It may collect your personal data and sell it.
dialogue.uz: U shaxsiy ma'lumotlaringizni yig'ib, sotishi mumkin.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Seriously? Could someone hack my phone like that?
dialogue.uz: Rostdanmi? Kimdir telefonimni shunday buzib kirishi mumkinmi?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: It could happen. I'd delete that game.
dialogue.uz: Bo'lishi mumkin. Men u o'yinni o'chirib tashlagan bo'lardim.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Done. And I'll turn off these notifications too.
dialogue.uz: Bo'ldi. Bu bildirishnomalarni ham o'chirib qo'yaman.

words.definition: a thing that gives power to phones and other devices
words.example: My phone battery is low.

words.definition: to put electricity into a battery
words.example: I need to charge my laptop.

words.definition: the right to do something
words.example: You need permission to enter this room.
words.exampleUz: Bu xonaga kirish uchun ruxsat kerak.

words.definition: a device for taking photos or videos
words.example: The camera on this phone is excellent.

words.definition: the place where something is
words.example: Send me your location, please.

words.definition: belonging to one particular person
words.example: Do not share personal information online.

words.definition: information, especially in a computer
words.example: The app stores your data safely.

words.definition: to get into a computer system without permission
words.example: Someone tried to hack my email.
words.exampleUz: Kimdir elektron pochtamni buzib kirishga urindi.

words.definition: to remove something from a computer or phone
words.example: Delete the old photos to free some space.
words.exampleUz: Joy bo'shatish uchun eski suratlarni o'chiring.

words.definition: a message that appears on your phone
words.example: I get too many notifications every day.
words.exampleUz: Har kuni juda ko'p bildirishnoma olaman.

description: Birinchi yordam qoidalarini tushuntirish.
story: Birinchi yordam darsidasiz. Doim to'g'ri bo'ladigan qoidalar va natijalar haqida gapirganda nol shart gap ishlatiladi: If + present, present.
grammarFocus: 0-shart gap: If a wound bleeds, you press on it

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: In an emergency, the first rule is simple: if you panic, you make mistakes.
dialogue.uz: Favqulodda vaziyatda birinchi qoida oddiy: vahimaga tushsangiz, xato qilasiz.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: So we must stay calm.
dialogue.uz: Demak, xotirjam qolishimiz kerak.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: Exactly. If someone is injured, you call an ambulance first. The number is 103.
dialogue.uz: Aynan. Kimdir jarohatlansa, avval tez yordam chaqirasiz. Raqami 103.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: What if a person is bleeding a lot?
dialogue.uz: Agar odamdan ko'p qon ketayotgan bo'lsa-chi?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: If a wound bleeds, you press on it with a clean cloth. That's basic first aid.
dialogue.uz: Yaradan qon ketsa, uni toza mato bilan bosib turasiz. Bu birinchi yordamning asosi.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: And if you burn your hand?
dialogue.uz: Qo'lingizni kuydirib olsangiz-chi?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: You put it under cold water for ten minutes.
dialogue.uz: Uni o'n daqiqa sovuq suv ostida ushlab turasiz.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: What happens if the smoke alarm goes off at home?
dialogue.uz: Uyda tutun signalizatsiyasi chalinsa nima bo'ladi?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: You leave the building and wait for the rescue team outside.
dialogue.uz: Binodan chiqasiz va qutqaruv guruhini tashqarida kutasiz.

words.definition: a sudden dangerous situation
words.example: In an emergency, call 112.

words.definition: a vehicle that takes ill people to hospital

words.exampleUz: Tez yordam besh daqiqada yetib keldi.

words.definition: hurt in an accident
words.example: Two people were injured in the accident.

words.definition: to lose blood
words.example: My finger is bleeding.

words.definition: the grey gas that comes from something burning

words.definition: a device that makes a loud noise to warn people

words.definition: relaxed and not worried

words.definition: saving someone from danger

words.definition: help, especially in a difficult situation

words.definition: to hurt yourself with fire or something hot

description: Kelajak haqida bashorat qilish va ehtimollarni muhokama qilish.
story: Yoz tobora issiq bo'lib borayotgani haqida gaplashyapsiz. Kelajak haqida ishonch bilan gapirishda will, ehtimol haqida esa be likely to ishlatiladi.
grammarFocus: Bashorat: will / be likely to

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Did you see the forecast? It's going to be forty-five degrees next week.
dialogue.uz: Ob-havo ma'lumotini ko'rdingizmi? Kelasi hafta qirq besh daraja bo'larkan.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Scientists predict that summers are likely to get even hotter.
dialogue.uz: Olimlar yozlar yanada issiqroq bo'lishi ehtimoli katta deb bashorat qilishyapti.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Why is the temperature rising so fast?
dialogue.uz: Harorat nega bunchalik tez ko'tarilyapti?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Mostly because of carbon from cars and factories. The whole planet is warming.
dialogue.uz: Asosan mashina va zavodlardan chiqadigan uglerod sabab. Butun sayyora isib bormoqda.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Will the Aral Sea come back one day?
dialogue.uz: Orol dengizi bir kun qaytib keladimi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Probably not. Much of it has become desert, and droughts are likely to increase.
dialogue.uz: Ehtimol yo'q. Uning katta qismi cho'lga aylandi, qurg'oqchilik esa ko'payishi ehtimoli katta.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Meanwhile, in other countries ice sheets melt and cities flood.
dialogue.uz: Shu bilan birga boshqa mamlakatlarda muzliklar eriydi, shaharlarni suv bosadi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: That's why renewable energy is so important. Solar panels will help a lot here.
dialogue.uz: Shuning uchun qayta tiklanadigan energiya juda muhim. Bu yerda quyosh panellari ko'p yordam beradi.

words.definition: how hot or cold something is
words.example: The temperature dropped at night.

words.definition: a long time with no rain
words.example: The drought destroyed the crops.

words.definition: to cover an area with water
words.example: The river may flood the village.

words.definition: to change from solid to liquid because of heat
words.example: The snow melts in March.

words.definition: a statement about what the weather will be like
words.example: The forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
words.exampleUz: Ob-havo ma'lumotiga ko'ra ertaga yomg'ir yog'adi.

words.definition: to say what will happen in the future
words.example: Nobody can predict the future.
words.exampleUz: Hech kim kelajakni bashorat qila olmaydi.

words.definition: a large round object in space, like the Earth
words.example: We only have one planet.

words.definition: a chemical that is in coal and oil and in the air as a gas
words.example: Cars produce a lot of carbon.

words.definition: coming from a source that never runs out, like the sun
words.example: Wind is a renewable source of energy.

words.definition: a large dry area of land with sand
words.example: The Kyzylkum is a huge desert.

description: Bo'sh ish o'rni haqida muloyim so'rash.
story: Siz bo'sh ish o'rni bo'yicha kadrlar bo'limiga qo'ng'iroq qildingiz. Rasmiy suhbatda to'g'ridan-to'g'ri savol o'rniga bilvosita savol ishlatiladi — so'z tartibi darak gapdagidek bo'ladi: Could you tell me when the deadline is?
grammarFocus: Bilvosita savol: Could you tell me what… / Do you know if…

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Good morning. I saw your vacancy for a sales manager online.
dialogue.uz: Xayrli tong. Internetda sotuv menejeri bo'sh ish o'rningizni ko'rdim.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.en: Yes, the position is still open.
dialogue.uz: Ha, bu lavozim hali bo'sh.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Could you tell me what the main requirements are?
dialogue.uz: Asosiy talablar qanday ekanini ayta olasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.en: We need a candidate with a degree and at least two years of experience.
dialogue.uz: Bizga diplomli va kamida ikki yillik tajribasi bor nomzod kerak.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Do you know if English is one of the qualifications?
dialogue.uz: Ingliz tili ham talab qilinadigan malakalardan biri ekanini bilasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.en: Yes. Many of the responsibilities include talking to foreign partners.
dialogue.uz: Ha. Vazifalarning ko'pchiligi xorijiy hamkorlar bilan gaplashishni o'z ichiga oladi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I'd like to know whether the working hours are flexible.
dialogue.uz: Ish vaqti moslashuvchan yoki yo'qligini bilmoqchi edim.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.en: Partly. As an employer, we offer two days from home.
dialogue.uz: Qisman. Ish beruvchi sifatida ikki kun uydan ishlashni taklif qilamiz.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Could you tell me when the deadline is?
dialogue.uz: Ariza topshirish muddati qachon tugashini ayta olasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.en: Friday. Please send your CV and one reference from your last job.
dialogue.uz: Juma kuni. Rezyumeingiz va oxirgi ishingizdan bitta tavsiyanoma yuboring.

words.definition: a job that is available
words.example: There is a vacancy for a driver.
words.exampleUz: Haydovchi uchun bo'sh ish o'rni bor.

words.definition: a job in a company
words.example: She applied for the position of manager.

words.definition: something that is necessary
words.example: A driving licence is a requirement for this job.
words.exampleUz: Bu ish uchun haydovchilik guvohnomasi talab qilinadi.

words.definition: a person who is trying to get a job
words.example: We interviewed five candidates today.
words.exampleUz: Bugun beshta nomzod bilan suhbat o'tkazdik.

words.definition: a skill or exam result that makes you suitable for a job
words.example: What qualifications do you have?

words.definition: a duty that you must do as part of your job
words.example: Training new staff is my responsibility.

words.definition: able to change easily
words.example: I have flexible working hours.

words.definition: a person or company that pays people to work
words.example: My employer pays for my English course.
words.exampleUz: Ish beruvchim ingliz tili kursimga pul to'laydi.

words.definition: the time by which you must finish something
words.example: The deadline for the report is Monday.

words.definition: a letter about you from a previous employer or teacher
words.example: My old boss gave me a good reference.
words.exampleUz: Sobiq rahbarim menga yaxshi tavsiyanoma berdi.

description: Yig'ilishda taklif berish va kelishish.
story: Ishdagi yig'ilishdasiz. Rahbarga yoki hamkasblarga taklif bildirishda buyruq emas, Let's, Why don't we va How about tuzilmalari ishlatiladi — bu muloyim va jamoaviy eshitiladi.
grammarFocus: Taklif: Let's… / Why don't we…? / How about…?

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.en: Let's start. The first point on the agenda is the new proposal.
dialogue.uz: Boshlaymiz. Kun tartibidagi birinchi masala — yangi taklif.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Before we discuss it, can I make a suggestion?
dialogue.uz: Uni muhokama qilishdan oldin bir taklif bildirsam maylimi?

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.en: Of course.
dialogue.uz: Albatta.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Why don't we postpone it until Friday? Two colleagues couldn't attend today.
dialogue.uz: Nega uni jumagacha qoldirmaymiz? Ikki hamkasbimiz bugun qatnasha olmadi.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.en: Good point. How about a brief update instead?
dialogue.uz: Yaxshi fikr. Uning o'rniga qisqacha ma'lumot bersak-chi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Sure. Our team is behind schedule, but only by two days.
dialogue.uz: Albatta. Jamoamiz jadvaldan orqada, lekin atigi ikki kunga.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.en: Let's send everyone a short summary after the meeting.
dialogue.uz: Yig'ilishdan keyin hammaga qisqa xulosa yuboraylik.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I'll write it and add the new schedule.
dialogue.uz: Men yozaman va yangi jadvalni qo'shaman.

words.definition: a list of things to discuss at a meeting
words.example: What is on the agenda today?

words.definition: a formal plan or suggestion
words.example: The board accepted our proposal.

words.definition: to talk about something with other people
words.example: We need to discuss the budget.

words.definition: an idea that you offer for someone to think about
words.example: Do you have any suggestions?

words.definition: to move an event to a later time
words.example: They had to postpone the wedding.

words.definition: a person you work with
words.example: My colleagues are very helpful.

words.definition: to go to an event, meeting or class
words.example: All students must attend the lecture.

words.definition: short, lasting only a little time
words.example: She gave a brief answer.

words.definition: a plan of when things will happen
words.example: The project is on schedule.

words.definition: a short statement of the main points
words.example: Please write a summary of the report.

description: Nosoz mahsulot bo'yicha muloyim murojaat qilish.
story: Yangi olgan buyumingiz ishlamayapti va do'kon xizmatiga qo'ng'iroq qildingiz. Rasmiy iltimosda Could you… va Would it be possible to… tuzilmalari eng xavfsiz tanlov.
grammarFocus: Muloyim iltimos: Could you…? / Would it be possible to…?

dialogue.speaker: Operator
dialogue.en: Thank you for calling. Could you hold for a moment, please?
dialogue.uz: Qo'ng'iroq uchun rahmat. Bir daqiqa kutib tura olasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Sure.
dialogue.uz: Albatta.

dialogue.speaker: Operator
dialogue.en: Thank you for being patient. I'm connecting you to extension 204.
dialogue.uz: Sabr qilganingiz uchun rahmat. Sizni 204-ichki raqamga ulayapman.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: Hello, I'm a customer service representative. How can I help?
dialogue.uz: Salom, men mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatish vakiliman. Qanday yordam bera olaman?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: The kettle I got last week is faulty. Would it be possible to get a replacement?
dialogue.uz: O'tgan hafta olgan choynagim nosoz chiqdi. Uni almashtirib olish mumkinmi?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: I'm sorry for the inconvenience. Is it still under warranty?
dialogue.uz: Noqulaylik uchun uzr. Hali kafolat muddatidami?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes, I have the invoice here.
dialogue.uz: Ha, hisob-faktura shu yerda.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: Could you send us a photo of it? We'll resolve this within three days.
dialogue.uz: Uning suratini yubora olasizmi? Muammoni uch kun ichida hal qilamiz.

words.definition: to wait on the phone
words.example: Please hold, I will connect you.

words.definition: able to wait calmly
words.example: Thank you for being so patient.

words.definition: one of many phone lines inside an office
words.example: Call me on extension 15.

words.definition: a person who speaks or acts for a company
words.example: A representative will call you back.

words.definition: not working correctly
words.example: The shop replaced the faulty cable.

words.definition: a new thing that takes the place of an old one
words.example: They sent me a replacement for free.

words.definition: a problem that causes you difficulty
words.example: We apologise for any inconvenience.
words.exampleUz: Har qanday noqulaylik uchun uzr so'raymiz.

words.definition: a written promise to repair a product for free
words.example: The TV has a two-year warranty.

words.definition: a document that lists things bought and their prices
words.example: We will email you the invoice.

words.definition: to find a solution to a problem
words.example: We resolved the problem quickly.

description: Taassurotlarni kuchli ifodalash.
story: Kechagi konsert haqida hayajon bilan gapiryapsiz. Taassurotni kuchaytirish uchun so (so good) sifat bilan, such (such an amazing feeling) esa ot bilan ishlatiladi.
grammarFocus: so + sifat / such (a) + ot

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: How was the concert last night?
dialogue.uz: Kechagi konsert qanday o'tdi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: It was so good! The band played for three hours.
dialogue.uz: Juda zo'r bo'ldi! Guruh uch soat chaldi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Was the audience big?
dialogue.uz: Tomoshabinlar ko'pmidi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: There were such a lot of people that I couldn't see the stage.
dialogue.uz: Shunchalik ko'p odam bor ediki, sahnani ko'ra olmadim.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Did they perform songs from the new album?
dialogue.uz: Yangi albomdagi qo'shiqlarni ijro etishdimi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes, and everyone knew the lyrics. It was such an amazing feeling.
dialogue.uz: Ha, hamma so'zlarini bilardi. Bu shunday ajoyib his edi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: I love their rhythm. The drummer is so talented.
dialogue.uz: Ularning ritmini yaxshi ko'raman. Barabanchisi juda iqtidorli.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: The singer also plays three instruments, including the dutar!
dialogue.uz: Xonanda uchta cholg'u asbobida ham chaladi, jumladan dutorda!

words.definition: a performance of music
words.example: We bought tickets for the concert.

words.definition: a group of musicians
words.example: My brother plays guitar in a band.

words.definition: the people watching a performance
words.example: The audience clapped for five minutes.

words.definition: the raised area where performers stand
words.example: The actors came back on stage.

words.definition: to sing, dance or act for an audience
words.example: She will perform at the festival.

words.definition: a collection of songs released together
words.example: Their new album is great.

words.definition: the words of a song
words.example: I can never remember the lyrics.
words.exampleUz: Qo'shiq so'zlarini hech eslab qola olmayman.

words.definition: very surprising and good
words.example: The view from the top was amazing.

words.definition: a regular pattern of sounds in music
words.example: This song has a fast rhythm.

words.definition: an object used to make music
words.example: Do you play any instrument?

description: Uyqu odatlari haqida gapirish va maslahat berish.
story: Yangi joyda yaxshi uxlay olmayapsiz. Biror narsaga o'rganib qolganlik be used to + -ing bilan ifodalanadi — used to (ilgari …ardim) bilan adashtirmang.
grammarFocus: be used to + -ing: I am used to sleeping in silence

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: You look sleepy. Didn't you sleep well?
dialogue.uz: Uyqusiraganga o'xshaysiz. Yaxshi uxlamadingizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I was awake until three. My new flatmate snores very loudly.
dialogue.uz: Soat uchgacha uyg'oq edim. Yangi xonadoshim juda qattiq xurrak otadi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Poor you! You're not used to sharing a room.
dialogue.uz: Bechora! Siz xonani baham ko'rishga o'rganmagansiz.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Exactly. At home I am used to sleeping in total silence.
dialogue.uz: Aynan. Uyda to'liq sukunatda uxlashga o'rganganman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Do you drink coffee in the evening? Caffeine keeps you awake.
dialogue.uz: Kechqurun qahva ichasizmi? Kofein uyg'oq ushlab turadi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Sometimes. And I often take a nap after lunch.
dialogue.uz: Ba'zan. Tushlikdan keyin ko'pincha mizg'ib olaman ham.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Try a regular bedtime routine: no screens, a warm blanket, and a book to help you relax.
dialogue.uz: Muntazam uyqu oldi tartibini sinab ko'ring: ekransiz, iliq ko'rpa va tinchlanish uchun kitob.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Maybe I also need a better pillow.
dialogue.uz: Balki menga yaxshiroq yostiq ham kerakdir.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: And earplugs! Sweet dreams.
dialogue.uz: Quloq tiqinlari ham! Shirin tushlar.

words.definition: not sleeping
words.example: I was awake all night.

words.definition: to breathe noisily while sleeping
words.example: My grandfather snores like a tractor.

words.definition: a substance in coffee and tea that keeps you awake
words.example: Green tea also has caffeine.

words.definition: a short sleep during the day
words.example: I had a short nap after work.

words.definition: the time when you usually go to bed
words.example: My bedtime is eleven o’clock.
words.exampleUz: Mening yotish vaqtim soat o'n bir.

words.definition: the usual order in which you do things
words.example: Exercise is part of my morning routine.
words.exampleUz: Mashq — ertalabki kun tartibimning bir qismi.

words.definition: a thick cover that keeps you warm in bed
words.example: It is cold, take another blanket.

words.definition: to rest and stop worrying
words.example: I listen to music to relax.

words.definition: a soft thing that you put your head on in bed
words.example: This pillow is too hard.

words.definition: pictures and stories in your mind while you sleep
words.example: I had a strange dream last night.

description: Yo'l qoidalari: nima shart, nima mumkin emas.
story: Haydovchilik guvohnomasini endigina oldingiz va instruktor qoidalarni takrorlayapti. mustn't — taqiq (mumkin emas), don't have to esa — majburiyat yo'q (shart emas). Bu ikkisini adashtirish xavfli.
grammarFocus: must / mustn't / don't have to

dialogue.speaker: Instructor
dialogue.en: You've just got your licence, so let's check the rules.
dialogue.uz: Guvohnomani endigina oldingiz, keling, qoidalarni tekshiramiz.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: OK. I must always wear my seatbelt.
dialogue.uz: Xo'p. Men doim xavfsizlik kamarini taqishim shart.

dialogue.speaker: Instructor
dialogue.en: Right. And you mustn't overtake on a bridge or near a crossing.
dialogue.uz: To'g'ri. Ko'prikda yoki piyodalar o'tish joyi yaqinida quvib o'tmaslik kerak.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: What happens if a pedestrian is crossing the road?
dialogue.uz: Agar piyoda yo'lni kesib o'tayotgan bo'lsa-chi?

dialogue.speaker: Instructor
dialogue.en: You must brake and let them pass.
dialogue.uz: Tormoz berib, uni o'tkazib yuborishingiz kerak.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Do I have to drive in the left lane on the highway?
dialogue.uz: Katta yo'lda chap qatorda yurishim shartmi?

dialogue.speaker: Instructor
dialogue.en: No, you don't have to. Use it only to overtake.
dialogue.uz: Yo'q, shart emas. Uni faqat quvib o'tish uchun ishlating.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: And can I park here?
dialogue.uz: Bu yerda to'xtab tursam bo'ladimi?

dialogue.speaker: Instructor
dialogue.en: Not here! You'll get a fine. In heavy traffic, most accidents happen because people are in a hurry.
dialogue.uz: Bu yerda emas! Jarima olasiz. Tig'iz harakatda ko'pchilik baxtsiz hodisalar odamlar shoshgani uchun sodir bo'ladi.

words.definition: an official document that allows you to do something
words.example: He got his driving licence at eighteen.
words.exampleUz: U o'n sakkiz yoshida haydovchilik guvohnomasini oldi.

words.definition: a belt in a car that keeps you in your seat
words.example: Please fasten your seatbelt.

words.definition: to go past another vehicle
words.example: Never overtake on a bend.

words.definition: a person who is walking in the street
words.example: Cars must stop for pedestrians.

words.definition: to make a vehicle go slower or stop
words.example: I had to brake suddenly.

words.definition: one part of a road, marked with lines
words.example: Stay in the right lane.

words.definition: to leave a car somewhere for a time
words.example: You cannot park in front of the gate.
words.exampleUz: Darvoza oldida mashina qo'yish mumkin emas.

words.definition: money you pay because you broke a rule
words.example: He paid a fine for speeding.
words.exampleUz: U tezlikni oshirgani uchun jarima to'ladi.

words.definition: the cars and other vehicles on a road
words.example: The traffic is terrible in the evening.

words.definition: a crash in which people may be hurt
words.example: Nobody was hurt in the accident.

description: Tarbiya haqida faraz qilib gapirish.
story: Farzand tarbiyasi haqida xayoliy vaziyatni muhokama qilyapsiz. Hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi real bo'lmagan vaziyatlar uchun ikkinchi shart gap ishlatiladi: If + past, would + fe'l.
grammarFocus: 2-shart gap: If you were a parent, how would you…?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: If you were a parent, how would you raise your children?
dialogue.uz: Ota-ona bo'lganingizda farzandlaringizni qanday tarbiyalardingiz?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I wouldn't be too strict. I'd allow them to make their own decisions.
dialogue.uz: Juda qattiqqo'l bo'lmasdim. O'z qarorlarini qabul qilishlariga ruxsat berardim.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: But if children had no rules, they wouldn't behave well.
dialogue.uz: Lekin bolalarda hech qanday qoida bo'lmasa, ular o'zini yaxshi tutmasdi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: True. I'd give them chores so they would become responsible.
dialogue.uz: To'g'ri. Mas'uliyatli bo'lishlari uchun ularga uy yumushlarini berardim.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: My parents praised me for every small thing.
dialogue.uz: Ota-onam har bir kichik narsa uchun meni maqtashardi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: That's nice, but if you praise children too much, you might spoil them.
dialogue.uz: Bu yaxshi, lekin bolalarni haddan ortiq maqtasangiz, ularni erkalatib yuborishingiz mumkin.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: What's most important to you?
dialogue.uz: Siz uchun eng muhimi nima?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: If my kids grew up independent and kind, I'd be happy.
dialogue.uz: Farzandlarim mustaqil va mehribon bo'lib ulg'aysa, baxtli bo'lardim.

words.definition: a mother or father
words.example: Both parents work full-time.
words.exampleUz: Ota-onaning ikkalasi ham to'liq kun ishlaydi.

words.definition: to take care of a child until it is an adult
words.example: She raised four children alone.
words.exampleUz: U to'rt farzandni yolg'iz o'zi tarbiyaladi.

words.definition: making people follow rules carefully
words.example: Our teacher is strict but fair.

words.definition: to let someone do something
words.example: My parents allow me to stay out until ten.
words.exampleUz: Ota-onam o'ngacha tashqarida qolishimga ruxsat berishadi.

words.definition: to act in a particular way
words.example: The children behaved very well today.
words.exampleUz: Bolalar bugun o'zini juda yaxshi tutishdi.

words.definition: a small job that you do regularly at home
words.example: Washing the dishes is my least favourite chore.

words.definition: able to be trusted to do the right thing
words.example: She is a very responsible student.

words.definition: to say that someone has done something well
words.example: The teacher praised my essay.

words.definition: to give a child everything they want, so they behave badly
