words.definition: not needing help from other people
words.example: He became independent at a young age.

description: Intervyu va yangiliklar haqida gapirib berish.
story: Sizdan intervyu olishdi va buni do'stingizga aytib beryapsiz. Birovning savolini yetkazishda so'z tartibi darak gapdagidek bo'ladi va zamon orqaga suriladi: "Why did you choose?" → she asked why I had chosen.
grammarFocus: Ko'chirma savol: She asked me why I had chosen… / whether I was…

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: A journalist called me yesterday for an article about young teachers.
dialogue.uz: Kecha bir jurnalist yosh o'qituvchilar haqidagi maqola uchun menga qo'ng'iroq qildi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Really? What did she ask?
dialogue.uz: Rostdanmi? U nimani so'radi?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: She asked me why I had chosen teaching, and whether I was happy with my salary.
dialogue.uz: Nega o'qituvchilikni tanlaganimni va maoshimdan mamnunmanmi-yo'qmi, deb so'radi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: When will they publish it?
dialogue.uz: Uni qachon chop etishadi?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: The editor said it would be online next week. It might even be on a TV channel.
dialogue.uz: Muharrir keyingi hafta internetda bo'lishini aytdi. Hatto biror telekanalda ham bo'lishi mumkin.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Great! But be careful with news these days. Many headlines are fake.
dialogue.uz: Ajoyib! Lekin hozir yangiliklarga ehtiyot bo'ling. Ko'p sarlavhalar soxta.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: I know. I always check if the source is reliable.
dialogue.uz: Bilaman. Manba ishonchli-ishonchsizligini doim tekshiraman.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Me too. I only trust news that official channels broadcast.
dialogue.uz: Men ham. Faqat rasmiy kanallar efirga uzatgan yangiliklarga ishonaman.

words.definition: a person who writes news for newspapers, TV or websites
words.example: She works as a sports journalist.

words.definition: a piece of writing in a newspaper or on a website
words.example: I read an interesting article about sleep.

words.definition: to print or put something online for people to read
words.example: The magazine will publish his story.

words.definition: a person who decides what goes into a newspaper or book
words.example: The editor changed the title.

words.definition: a TV station, or a place online where videos are shared
words.example: Which channel is the match on?

words.definition: the title of a news story
words.example: The headline was on every front page.
words.exampleUz: Bu sarlavha barcha gazetalarning birinchi sahifasida edi.

words.definition: not real, made to trick people
words.example: That news story is fake.

words.definition: where information comes from
words.example: Always check the source of the news.

words.definition: able to be trusted
words.example: We need reliable information.

words.definition: to send out a programme on TV or radio
words.example: The match will be broadcast live.

description: Milliy bayram an'analarini chet ellikka tushuntirish.
story: Chet ellik do'stingizga Navro'z haqida gapirib beryapsiz. An'analar haqida gapirganda kim qilishi emas, nima qilinishi muhim — shuning uchun Present Passive ishlatiladi: It is celebrated…
grammarFocus: Hozirgi zamon majhul nisbati: is celebrated, are decorated

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.en: What is Navruz? Everyone is talking about it.
dialogue.uz: Navro'z nima? Hamma u haqda gapiryapti.

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: It's the spring festival. It is celebrated on the twenty-first of March.
dialogue.uz: Bu bahor bayrami. U 21-martda nishonlanadi.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.en: Is it a public holiday?
dialogue.uz: Bu dam olish kunimi?

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: Yes. It's a very old tradition — a symbol of new life.
dialogue.uz: Ha. Bu juda qadimiy an'ana — yangi hayot ramzi.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.en: How is it celebrated?
dialogue.uz: U qanday nishonlanadi?

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: Special dishes are prepared, and streets are decorated with flowers.
dialogue.uz: Maxsus taomlar tayyorlanadi, ko'chalar gullar bilan bezatiladi.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.en: I've heard about sumalak.
dialogue.uz: Sumalak haqida eshitganman.

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: It is cooked overnight, and women take turns to stir it. That's an important custom.
dialogue.uz: U tun bo'yi pishiriladi, ayollar navbatma-navbat uni aralashtirishadi. Bu muhim odat.

words.definition: the season between winter and summer
words.example: Trees start to grow leaves in spring.

words.definition: a special time of celebration
words.example: The city holds a music festival every year.
words.exampleUz: Shaharda har yili musiqa festivali o'tkaziladi.

words.definition: a day when people do not go to work
words.example: Monday is a public holiday.

words.definition: a custom that has existed for a long time
words.example: Drinking green tea is a family tradition.

words.definition: a sign or picture that has a special meaning
words.example: The dove is a symbol of peace.

words.definition: to make something ready
words.example: We prepare the table for our guests.

words.definition: to make something look beautiful
words.example: Children decorate the classroom with pictures.

words.definition: during the whole night
words.example: Leave the dough overnight.

words.definition: to move a spoon round in a liquid
words.example: Stir the soup slowly.

words.definition: a traditional way of doing something
words.example: It is a local custom to bring bread.

description: O'tgan yo'lni baholash va kelajak maqsadini qo'yish.
story: Siz 60-kunga yetdingiz — B1 bloki shu yerda tugaydi. O'qituvchingiz bilan yutuqlaringizni sarhisob qilyapsiz. Bu dialogda o'rgangan zamonlaringiz birga ishlatiladi.
grammarFocus: Aralash takror: Past Simple, Present Perfect, Future

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: Congratulations! You have reached day sixty. That's a real milestone.
dialogue.uz: Tabriklayman! Oltmishinchi kunga yetdingiz. Bu haqiqiy muhim bosqich.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Thank you. Two months ago I couldn't order coffee in English.
dialogue.uz: Rahmat. Ikki oy oldin ingliz tilida qahva buyurtma qila olmasdim.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: Let's reflect a little. What is your biggest achievement so far?
dialogue.uz: Keling, biroz mulohaza qilaylik. Hozirgacha eng katta yutug'ingiz nima?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: My confidence. I'm not afraid of speaking any more.
dialogue.uz: Ishonchim. Endi gapirishdan qo'rqmayman.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: And what is your main strength?
dialogue.uz: Asosiy kuchli tomoningiz-chi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I have been consistent — I have studied every day, even when my motivation was low.
dialogue.uz: Izchil bo'ldim — hatto motivatsiyam past bo'lgan kunlari ham har kuni o'qidim.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: That effort pays off. Learning a language needs patience.
dialogue.uz: Bu mehnat o'z samarasini beradi. Til o'rganish sabr talab qiladi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: My aim now is to reach B2 by the end of the course.
dialogue.uz: Endi maqsadim — kurs oxirigacha B2 ga yetish.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: If you keep going like this, you will.
dialogue.uz: Shunday davom etsangiz, albatta yetasiz.

words.definition: an important event in a process
words.example: Finishing school is a big milestone.

words.definition: to think carefully about something
words.example: Take some time to reflect on your progress.
words.exampleUz: Yutuqlaringiz haqida mulohaza qilishga vaqt ajrating.

words.definition: something good that you did with effort
words.example: Winning the prize was a great achievement.

words.definition: the feeling that you can do things well
words.example: Speaking every day gives you confidence.

words.definition: a good quality or ability
words.example: Patience is one of her strengths.

words.definition: always doing something in the same way
words.example: Be consistent and practise every day.
words.exampleUz: Izchil bo'ling va har kuni mashq qiling.

words.definition: the wish to do something
words.example: My motivation is my family.

words.definition: the energy you use to do something
words.example: Learning a skill takes time and effort.
words.exampleUz: Mahorat o'rganish vaqt va mehnat talab qiladi.

words.definition: the ability to wait calmly
words.example: Teaching children needs a lot of patience.
words.exampleUz: Bolalarni o'qitish katta sabr talab qiladi.

words.definition: something you hope to achieve
words.example: Our aim is to finish the project by May.

description: Charchoq va chegaralar haqida fikr bildirish.
story: Do'stingiz ishdan haddan ortiq charchagan. Qarama-qarshilikni ifodalashda although'dan keyin to'liq gap, despite va in spite of'dan keyin esa ot yoki -ing keladi.
grammarFocus: although / despite / in spite of

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: You've been working overtime every day this month.
dialogue.uz: Bu oy har kuni qo'shimcha ishlayapsiz.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I know. Although I love my job, the workload is huge.
dialogue.uz: Bilaman. Ishimni yaxshi ko'rsam ham, yuklama juda katta.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Despite the extra hours, are you more productive?
dialogue.uz: Qo'shimcha soatlarga qaramay, samaraliroq bo'ldingizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Honestly, no. I'm exhausted, and I have no leisure time at all.
dialogue.uz: Rostini aytsam, yo'q. Juda holdan toydim va umuman bo'sh vaqtim yo'q.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: That's how burnout starts. You need to find a better balance.
dialogue.uz: Tushkunlik aynan shunday boshlanadi. Yaxshiroq muvozanat topishingiz kerak.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: In spite of the pressure, I don't want to disappoint my boss.
dialogue.uz: Bosimga qaramay, rahbarimni xafa qilishni istamayman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Then set boundaries. Prioritise the important tasks and say no to the rest.
dialogue.uz: Unda chegaralar qo'ying. Muhim vazifalarni birinchi o'ringa qo'ying, qolganiga yo'q deng.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: You're right. No job is worth sacrificing my health.
dialogue.uz: Haqsiz. Hech bir ish sog'lig'imni qurbon qilishga arzimaydi.

words.definition: extra hours that you work after your normal time
words.example: He works overtime to earn more money.
words.exampleUz: U ko'proq pul topish uchun qo'shimcha ishlaydi.

words.definition: the amount of work you have to do
words.example: Teachers have a heavy workload in June.
words.exampleUz: Iyunda o'qituvchilarning ish yuklamasi og'ir bo'ladi.

words.definition: doing or achieving a lot
words.example: I am most productive in the morning.

words.definition: extremely tired
words.example: After the long flight I was exhausted.

words.definition: time when you are not working
words.example: Reading is my favourite leisure activity.

words.definition: extreme tiredness caused by working too hard
words.example: Many doctors suffer from burnout.
words.exampleUz: Ko'plab shifokorlar haddan ortiq charchoqdan aziyat chekadi.

words.definition: a state where different things have equal importance
words.example: It is hard to find a balance between work and family.
words.exampleUz: Ish va oila o'rtasida muvozanat topish qiyin.

words.definition: a limit that you set for yourself or others
words.example: You should set clear boundaries at work.

words.definition: to decide what is most important and do it first
words.example: Learn to prioritise your tasks.

words.definition: to give up something important for another thing
words.example: She sacrificed her free time to help her family.
words.exampleUz: U oilasiga yordam berish uchun bo'sh vaqtini qurbon qildi.

description: Shartlar qo'yib muzokara olib borish.
story: Sizga ish taklif qilishdi va endi maosh bo'yicha kelishyapsiz. Shart qo'yishda unless (…masa), as long as va provided that (…sa, faqat shunda) ishlatiladi.
grammarFocus: unless / as long as / provided that

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.en: We'd like to offer you the job. The salary is eight million sums.
dialogue.uz: Sizga bu ishni taklif qilmoqchimiz. Maoshi sakkiz million so'm.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Thank you. Could we negotiate? I believe I deserve a little more.
dialogue.uz: Rahmat. Kelishib olsak bo'ladimi? Menimcha, biroz ko'proqqa loyiqman.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.en: Can you justify that?
dialogue.uz: Buni asoslab bera olasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes. My performance at my last job was excellent, and I speak three languages.
dialogue.uz: Ha. Oldingi ishimdagi natijalarim a'lo edi va uch tilda gapiraman.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.en: We can't change the base salary unless the director agrees. But we could add a bonus.
dialogue.uz: Direktor rozi bo'lmasa, asosiy maoshni o'zgartira olmaymiz. Lekin bonus qo'shishimiz mumkin.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: That would be fine, as long as it's in the contract.
dialogue.uz: Bu ma'qul, faqat shartnomada yozilgan bo'lsa.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.en: Of course. You'll also get health insurance and other benefits.
dialogue.uz: Albatta. Tibbiy sug'urta va boshqa imtiyozlar ham olasiz.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: And an increase after six months, provided that I reach my targets?
dialogue.uz: Maqsadlarimga erishsam, olti oydan keyin oshirish ham bo'ladimi?

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.en: Agreed. I think that's a fair compromise.
dialogue.uz: Kelishdik. Menimcha, bu adolatli murosa.

words.definition: to say you will give something to someone
words.example: They offered me a job in Tashkent.

words.definition: to discuss something to reach an agreement
words.example: We need to negotiate the price.

words.definition: to have earned something because of what you did
words.example: You deserve a holiday after all that work.
words.exampleUz: Shuncha ishdan keyin dam olishga loyiqsiz.

words.definition: to give a good reason for something
words.example: How can you justify such a high price?
words.exampleUz: Bunday yuqori narxni qanday asoslay olasiz?

words.definition: how well someone does a job
words.example: Her performance this year was outstanding.
words.exampleUz: Uning bu yilgi ish natijalari ajoyib bo'ldi.

words.definition: extra money added to your salary
words.example: Everyone got a bonus at the end of the year.
words.exampleUz: Yil oxirida hamma mukofot puli oldi.

words.definition: an agreement that pays you money if something bad happens
words.example: Health insurance is expensive here.

words.definition: something extra that you get from your job
words.example: Free lunch is one of the benefits.

words.definition: a rise in amount or number
words.example: There was a large increase in prices.

words.definition: an agreement where each side accepts less than it wanted
words.example: After a long talk, we reached a compromise.

description: O'tmishdagi boshqacha natijalar haqida faraz qilish.
story: Do'stingiz bir necha yil oldingi imkoniyatni eslayapti. O'tmishda bo'lmagan voqea va uning natijasi haqida gapirishda uchinchi shart gap ishlatiladi: If + had done, would have done.
grammarFocus: 3-shart gap: If I had applied, they would have accepted me

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Is it true you were offered a scholarship in Korea?
dialogue.uz: Koreyada grant taklif qilingani rostmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes, three years ago. But I hesitated, and I sent my application too late.
dialogue.uz: Ha, uch yil oldin. Lekin ikkilandim va arizamni juda kech yubordim.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: What happened?
dialogue.uz: Nima bo'ldi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: They rejected it. If I had applied on time, they would have accepted me.
dialogue.uz: Uni rad etishdi. Vaqtida topshirganimda, meni qabul qilishgan bo'lardi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: That's a pity. Would you have studied medicine there?
dialogue.uz: Attang. U yerda tibbiyotni o'qigan bo'larmidingiz?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Probably. But if I had gone, I wouldn't have met my wife!
dialogue.uz: Ehtimol. Lekin ketganimda, xotinim bilan tanishmagan bo'lardim-da!

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: So every choice has a consequence.
dialogue.uz: Demak, har bir tanlovning oqibati bor.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Exactly. I realised that too late, but now I'm determined not to miss the next chance.
dialogue.uz: Aynan. Buni juda kech angladim, lekin endi keyingi imkoniyatni boy bermaslikka qat'iy qaror qildim.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Are you going to pursue a master's degree?
dialogue.uz: Magistraturada o'qishni davom ettirmoqchimisiz?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes, and this time I won't wait.
dialogue.uz: Ha, bu safar kutib o'tirmayman.

words.definition: money given to a student to pay for studies
words.example: She won a scholarship to study in Japan.
words.exampleUz: U Yaponiyada o'qish uchun grant yutdi.

words.definition: to wait before you do something because you are not sure
words.example: Do not hesitate to call me.

words.definition: a formal written request for a job or a place
words.example: I filled in the application online.

words.definition: to say no to something or someone
words.example: The bank rejected his request for a loan.
words.exampleUz: Bank uning kredit so'rovini rad etdi.

words.definition: to say yes to something that is offered
words.example: I accepted their invitation.

words.definition: a result of an action, often a bad one
words.example: Think about the consequences before you decide.
words.exampleUz: Qaror qilishdan oldin oqibatlari haqida o'ylang.

words.definition: to understand something that you did not know before
words.example: I did not realise it was so late.

words.definition: having a strong wish to do something
words.example: She is determined to become a doctor.
words.exampleUz: U shifokor bo'lishga qat'iy qaror qilgan.

words.definition: an opportunity to do something
words.example: This is your last chance to apply.
words.exampleUz: Bu ariza topshirish uchun oxirgi imkoniyatingiz.

words.definition: to try to achieve something over a long time
words.example: He left his job to pursue his dream.
words.exampleUz: U orzusiga intilish uchun ishidan ketdi.

description: Hozirgi va o'tmishdagi istaklarni ifodalash.
story: Do'stingiz bilan hayotdagi afsuslar haqida gaplashyapsiz. Hozirgi holatdan norozilik uchun wish + past (I wish I were), o'tmishdagi afsus uchun wish + past perfect (I wish I had learned) ishlatiladi.
grammarFocus: wish / if only: I wish I were…, I wish I had learned…

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: Do you have any regrets?
dialogue.uz: Biror narsadan afsuslanasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: One. I wish I had learned English in my youth, when it was easier.
dialogue.uz: Bittasi bor. Kashki ingliz tilini yoshligimda, osonroq paytda o'rgangan bo'lsam.

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: I wish I were a student again. Life was so carefree then.
dialogue.uz: Kashki yana talaba bo'lsam. U paytda hayot juda beg'am edi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: If only I had more free time now! My job is so stressful.
dialogue.uz: Qani endi hozir bo'sh vaqtim ko'proq bo'lsa! Ishim juda asabiy.

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: Can you imagine living without any work at all?
dialogue.uz: Umuman ishsiz yashashni tasavvur qila olasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: That would be a luxury, but I'd get bored. I still have one big ambition.
dialogue.uz: Bu hashamat bo'lardi, lekin zerikib qolardim. Hali bitta katta orzum bor.

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: What is it?
dialogue.uz: Qanday?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: To open my own school. I hope I fulfil it one day.
dialogue.uz: O'z maktabimni ochish. Umid qilamanki, bir kun uni amalga oshiraman.

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.en: You will. And we should appreciate what we have now.
dialogue.uz: Oshirasiz. Va hozir borimizni qadrlashimiz kerak.

words.definition: a feeling of being sorry about something you did or did not do
words.example: My only regret is that I left school early.

words.definition: to want something that is not possible or not true now
words.example: I wish I could speak French.

words.definition: the time of life when you are young
words.example: In his youth he was a good footballer.

words.definition: having no worries or problems
words.example: We spent a carefree summer by the sea.

words.definition: making you feel worried and tense
words.example: Moving house is very stressful.

words.definition: to form a picture of something in your mind
words.example: Imagine a world without the internet.

words.definition: something expensive that you enjoy but do not need
words.example: A long holiday is a luxury for me.
words.exampleUz: Uzoq dam olish men uchun hashamat.

words.definition: a strong wish to achieve something
words.example: Her ambition is to become a pilot.

words.definition: to do what you hoped or promised to do
words.example: It took him ten years to fulfil his dream.
words.exampleUz: Orzusini amalga oshirishga o'n yil ketdi.

words.definition: to understand how good or important something is
words.example: I really appreciate your help.

description: Kelajakdagi ish tartibi haqida gapirish.
story: Do'stingiz uydan ishlashni boshlamoqchi. Kelajakdagi ma'lum paytda davom etayotgan ish uchun Future Continuous (will be working), shu paytgacha tugagan ish uchun Future Perfect (will have finished) ishlatiladi.
grammarFocus: Future Continuous / Future Perfect: I'll be working… / I'll have finished…

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: This time next month, I'll be working from home.
dialogue.uz: Kelasi oy aynan shu paytda uydan ishlayotgan bo'laman.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Lucky you! Is it a remote job or freelance?
dialogue.uz: Omadingiz bor! Bu masofaviy ishmi yoki frilansmi?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Remote. I'll be collaborating with a team in Berlin.
dialogue.uz: Masofaviy. Berlindagi jamoa bilan hamkorlikda ishlayman.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: What about the time zone?
dialogue.uz: Vaqt mintaqasi-chi?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: It's four hours behind, so by the time they start, I'll have finished half my work.
dialogue.uz: To'rt soat orqada, shuning uchun ular boshlaganda men ishimning yarmini tugatgan bo'laman.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Don't you think you'll feel isolated?
dialogue.uz: O'zingizni jamiyatdan ajralib qolgandek his qilmaysizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Maybe. And home is full of distractions. I'll need discipline.
dialogue.uz: Balki. Uy esa chalg'ituvchi narsalarga to'la. Menga intizom kerak bo'ladi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Many studies say productivity goes up at home.
dialogue.uz: Ko'p tadqiqotlar uyda unumdorlik oshadi deydi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: I hope so. The company is sending me all the equipment, so I can be efficient from day one.
dialogue.uz: Umid qilaman. Kompaniya menga barcha jihozlarni yuboryapti, shuning uchun birinchi kundan samarali ishlay olaman.

words.definition: done from a different place, usually from home
words.example: More people want remote jobs now.
words.exampleUz: Hozir ko'proq odamlar masofaviy ish istaydi.

words.definition: working for different companies, not employed by one
words.example: She is a freelance designer.

words.definition: to work together with someone
words.example: Two universities collaborated on the project.

words.definition: an area with a particular feature
words.example: London is in a different time zone.

words.definition: feeling alone and without contact with others
words.example: Old people who live alone often feel isolated.
words.exampleUz: Yolg'iz yashaydigan keksalar ko'pincha o'zini ajralib qolgandek his qiladi.

words.definition: something that takes your attention away
words.example: My phone is my biggest distraction.

words.definition: the ability to control yourself and work hard
words.example: Learning alone requires discipline.

words.definition: how much work is done in a period of time

words.definition: working well without wasting time or energy

description: Moliyaviy qarorlarni muhokama qilish.
story: Jamg'armangizni qayerga qo'yishni o'ylayapsiz. Odam yoki narsa haqida QO'SHIMCHA ma'lumot vergul bilan ajratiladi: My uncle, who works at a bank, … — bunday gapda that ishlatilmaydi.
grammarFocus: Qo'shimcha ma'lumot beruvchi ergash gap: My uncle, who works at a bank, …

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: My uncle, who works at a bank, says I should invest my savings.
dialogue.uz: Bankda ishlaydigan amakim jamg'armamni investitsiya qilishim kerak deydi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: In what? Stocks?
dialogue.uz: Nimaga? Aksiyalargami?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Maybe. But stocks, which can bring high profits, are also risky.
dialogue.uz: Balki. Lekin yuqori foyda keltirishi mumkin bo'lgan aksiyalar xavfli ham.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: What about gold? It's more secure when inflation is high.
dialogue.uz: Oltin-chi? Inflyatsiya yuqori bo'lganda u xavfsizroq.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: True. And I don't want to keep everything in one currency.
dialogue.uz: To'g'ri. Hammasini bitta valyutada saqlashni ham istamayman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Are you still paying the loan for your car?
dialogue.uz: Mashinangiz uchun kreditni hali to'layapsizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes, but I'll repay it by summer. After that I'll have no debt.
dialogue.uz: Ha, lekin yozgacha to'lab bo'laman. Undan keyin hech qanday qarzim qolmaydi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Then you could get a mortgage, which would help you buy a flat.
dialogue.uz: Unda ipoteka olishingiz mumkin, bu kvartira sotib olishga yordam beradi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Good idea. I'll talk to a financial adviser first.
dialogue.uz: Yaxshi fikr. Avval moliyaviy maslahatchi bilan gaplashaman.

words.definition: to put money into something to make a profit
words.example: He invested all his money in property.
words.exampleUz: U butun pulini ko'chmas mulkka sarmoya qildi.

words.definition: a share in a company that you can buy
words.example: She bought stock in a tech company.
words.exampleUz: U texnologiya kompaniyasining aksiyalarini sotib oldi.

words.definition: safe and not likely to be lost
words.example: Gold is a secure investment.

words.definition: a general rise in prices
words.example: Inflation makes our savings worth less.

words.definition: the money used in a country
words.example: The sum is the currency of Uzbekistan.

words.definition: money that you borrow from a bank
words.example: They took a loan to open a café.
words.exampleUz: Ular kafe ochish uchun kredit olishdi.

words.definition: to pay back money that you borrowed
words.example: I will repay you next month.

words.definition: money that you owe someone
words.example: He is trying to get out of debt.

words.definition: a loan to buy a house or flat
words.example: They will pay off the mortgage in twenty years.
words.exampleUz: Ular ipotekani yigirma yilda to'lab bo'lishadi.

words.definition: a person whose job is to give advice
words.example: Talk to a financial adviser before you invest.
words.exampleUz: Sarmoya kiritishdan oldin moliyaviy maslahatchi bilan gaplashing.

description: Texnologiyaning jamiyatga ta'sirini muhokama qilish.
story: Sun'iy intellekt kelajakda ishimizni egallaydimi, degan bahs. Imkoniyat yoki majburiyatni harakat bajaruvchisiz ifodalash uchun modal + be + V3 ishlatiladi: it must be checked.
grammarFocus: Modal + majhul nisbat: can be used, must be checked, should be regulated

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Do you think artificial intelligence will take our jobs?
dialogue.uz: Sun'iy intellekt ishimizni tortib oladi deb o'ylaysizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Some jobs will be automated, but not all. Many tasks can't be done by machines.
dialogue.uz: Ba'zi ishlar avtomatlashtiriladi, lekin hammasi emas. Ko'p vazifalarni mashinalar bajara olmaydi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: But AI can already be used to translate texts and even write code.
dialogue.uz: Lekin sun'iy intellektdan allaqachon matn tarjima qilish va hatto kod yozish uchun foydalanish mumkin.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: True, but its answers must be checked. They aren't always accurate.
dialogue.uz: To'g'ri, lekin uning javoblari tekshirilishi kerak. Ular har doim ham aniq emas.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Why not?
dialogue.uz: Nega?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Every algorithm learns from data, and the data may contain bias.
dialogue.uz: Har bir algoritm ma'lumotlardan o'rganadi, ma'lumotlarda esa noxolislik bo'lishi mumkin.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: So should AI be regulated?
dialogue.uz: Demak, sun'iy intellekt qonun bilan tartibga solinishi kerakmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I think so. There are serious ethical questions that must be answered.
dialogue.uz: Menimcha, ha. Javob berilishi kerak bo'lgan jiddiy axloqiy savollar bor.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: At least boring work could be eliminated.
dialogue.uz: Hech bo'lmaganda zerikarli ishlarni yo'q qilish mumkin.

words.definition: made by people, not natural
words.example: The park has an artificial lake.

words.definition: the ability to learn and understand
words.example: Dolphins are known for their intelligence.

words.definition: to make a process work by machines
words.example: The factory automated most of its work.

words.definition: a piece of work that you must do
words.example: My first task was to answer emails.
words.exampleUz: Birinchi vazifam elektron xatlarga javob berish edi.

words.definition: correct in every detail
words.example: The weather forecast was accurate.

words.definition: a set of rules a computer follows to solve a problem
words.example: The app uses an algorithm to suggest videos.
words.exampleUz: Ilova videolarni tavsiya qilish uchun algoritmdan foydalanadi.

words.definition: an unfair preference for or against something
words.example: The report showed a clear bias against women.
words.exampleUz: Hisobot ayollarga nisbatan aniq noxolislikni ko'rsatdi.

words.definition: to control something with rules
words.example: The government regulates food prices.

words.definition: connected with what is morally right
words.example: Is it ethical to test products on animals?
words.exampleUz: Mahsulotlarni hayvonlarda sinash axloqqa to'g'ri keladimi?

words.definition: to remove something completely
words.example: We want to eliminate paper forms.

description: Dalillarga asoslanib xulosa chiqarish.
story: Muzeydan rasm o'g'irlandi va siz do'stingiz bilan kim qilgani haqida taxmin qilyapsiz. O'tmish haqida ishonchli xulosa must have done, imkonsizligi esa can't have done bilan ifodalanadi.
grammarFocus: O'tmish haqida taxmin: must have / can't have + V3

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Did you hear? Someone broke into the museum last night.
dialogue.uz: Eshitdingizmi? Kecha kimdir muzeyga o'g'rilikka tushibdi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes! The police are investigating. The thief must have known the building well.
dialogue.uz: Ha! Politsiya tergov qilyapti. O'g'ri binoni yaxshi bilgan bo'lsa kerak.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Why do you think so?
dialogue.uz: Nega shunday deb o'ylaysiz?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: The alarm didn't ring, so he must have turned it off. That's an important clue.
dialogue.uz: Signal chalinmagan, demak u uni o'chirib qo'ygan bo'lishi kerak. Bu muhim iz.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Is there any evidence?
dialogue.uz: Biror dalil bormi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: They found a footprint near the window, and a witness saw a man at midnight.
dialogue.uz: Deraza yonida oyoq izi topishdi, bir guvoh esa yarim tunda bir erkakni ko'ribdi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Do they have a suspect?
dialogue.uz: Gumondor bormi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: The guard. But he can't have done it — he has an alibi. He was at a wedding.
dialogue.uz: Qo'riqchi. Lekin u buni qilgan bo'lishi mumkin emas — alibisi bor. U to'yda edi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Then what was the motive? Why would anyone steal an old painting?
dialogue.uz: Unda maqsad nima edi? Nega kimdir eski rasmni o'g'irlaydi?

words.definition: to try to find out the truth about something
words.example: The police are investigating the accident.

words.definition: a person who steals
words.example: The thief escaped through the back door.

words.definition: a piece of information that helps you solve a problem
words.example: The detective found an important clue.

words.definition: facts or objects that show something is true
words.example: There is no evidence that he was there.
words.exampleUz: Uning u yerda bo'lgani haqida hech qanday dalil yo'q.

words.definition: a mark made by a foot or shoe
words.example: We saw footprints in the snow.

words.definition: a person who sees something happen
words.example: A witness saw the car leave.

words.definition: a person who may have committed a crime
words.example: The police arrested two suspects.

words.definition: proof that you were somewhere else when a crime happened
words.example: His alibi was that he was at work.
words.exampleUz: Uning alibisi — o'sha paytda ishda bo'lgani.

words.definition: a reason for doing something
words.example: Money was the motive for the crime.

words.definition: to take something that is not yours
words.example: Someone tried to steal my bike.

description: Ishni boshqa odamga qildirish haqida gapirish.
story: Uyingizda ta'mirlash ishlari bo'ldi. Ishni o'zingiz emas, usta qilganini ko'rsatish uchun have something done ishlatiladi — o'zbek tilidagi "-tir" (o'rnattirdim) qo'shimchasiga o'xshaydi.
grammarFocus: Kauzativ: have/get something done — I had a new tap installed

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Your kitchen looks different!
dialogue.uz: Oshxonangiz boshqacha ko'rinyapti!

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: I had a new tap installed. The old one had a leak for weeks.
dialogue.uz: Yangi jo'mrak o'rnattirdim. Eskisidan bir necha hafta suv oqib yotgandi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Did you do it yourself?
dialogue.uz: O'zingiz qildingizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: No way! I got a plumber to do it. He also checked the pipes.
dialogue.uz: Qani edi! Santexnikka qildirdim. U quvurlarni ham tekshirdi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: I need to have my lights repaired. Do you know a good electrician?
dialogue.uz: Men chiroqlarimni ta'mirlatishim kerak. Yaxshi elektrik bilasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Yes, but ask for an estimate first. Some are very expensive.
dialogue.uz: Ha, lekin avval taxminiy narxni so'rang. Ba'zilari juda qimmat.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: And my car needs a service too.
dialogue.uz: Mashinamga ham texnik xizmat kerak.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Make an appointment with my mechanic. Regular maintenance saves money.
dialogue.uz: Mening ustamga yoziling. Muntazam texnik parvarish pulni tejaydi.

words.definition: to put equipment in place so it is ready to use
words.example: We installed air conditioning last summer.

words.definition: a device that controls the flow of water
words.example: Turn off the tap when you brush your teeth.

words.definition: a hole through which liquid or gas escapes
words.example: There is a leak in the roof.

words.definition: a person who fixes water pipes
words.example: Call a plumber — the pipe is broken.

words.definition: a person who fixes electrical systems
words.example: The electrician fixed the lights in an hour.

words.definition: a guess of how much something will cost
words.example: The builder gave us an estimate.

words.definition: a regular check of a car or machine
words.example: My car goes for a service every year.
words.exampleUz: Mashinam har yili texnik xizmatdan o'tadi.

words.definition: an arranged meeting at a particular time
words.example: I have an appointment with the dentist.

words.definition: a person who repairs cars
words.example: The mechanic changed the oil.

words.definition: keeping something in good condition
words.example: The building needs regular maintenance.

description: Natijalarni tartibli va ishonarli taqdim etish.
story: Hamkasblaringiz oldida yillik natijalarni taqdim etyapsiz. Nutqni tartibli va ishonarli qilish uchun bog'lovchi so'zlar ishlatiladi — ular tinglovchiga fikringiz qayoqqa ketayotganini ko'rsatadi.
grammarFocus: Bog'lovchilar: firstly, moreover, however, furthermore, in conclusion

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Good morning, everyone. In this presentation, I'll outline our results for the year.
dialogue.uz: Hammaga xayrli tong. Bu taqdimotda yil natijalarimizni qisqacha bayon qilaman.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Firstly, let's look at this slide. Sales grew by twenty percent.
dialogue.uz: Birinchidan, keling, ushbu slaydga qaraymiz. Savdo yigirma foizga o'sdi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Moreover, we opened two new shops in Fergana and Namangan.
dialogue.uz: Bundan tashqari, Farg'ona va Namanganda ikkita yangi do'kon ochdik.

dialogue.speaker: Colleague
dialogue.en: Could you highlight the main problems too?
dialogue.uz: Asosiy muammolarni ham alohida ta'kidlab bera olasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Of course. However, online sales were lower than we expected.
dialogue.uz: Albatta. Biroq onlayn savdo kutganimizdan past bo'ldi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: One statistic surprised us: most customers still pay in cash.
dialogue.uz: Bitta statistik ko'rsatkich bizni hayron qoldirdi: ko'pchilik mijozlar hali ham naqd to'laydi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Furthermore, delivery costs have gone up.
dialogue.uz: Bundan tashqari, yetkazib berish xarajatlari oshdi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: In conclusion, it was a good year, but we must improve our website.
dialogue.uz: Xulosa qilib aytganda, yil yaxshi o'tdi, lekin veb-saytimizni yaxshilashimiz kerak.

words.definition: a talk that gives information to a group
words.example: She gave a presentation about the new product.
words.exampleUz: U yangi mahsulot haqida taqdimot qildi.

words.definition: to describe the main facts or ideas
words.example: Let me outline the plan.

words.definition: used to introduce the first point
words.example: Firstly, I would like to thank you all.

words.definition: one page of a computer presentation
words.example: The next slide shows our sales.

words.definition: used to add more information
words.example: The flat is cheap. Moreover, it is near the metro.
words.exampleUz: Kvartira arzon. Bundan tashqari, metroga yaqin.

words.definition: to show that something is especially important
words.example: The report highlights the need for change.

words.definition: used to introduce a contrast
words.example: It was sunny. However, it was very cold.
words.exampleUz: Havo quyoshli edi. Biroq juda sovuq edi.

words.definition: a number that gives information about something
words.example: This statistic shows how many people read books.
words.exampleUz: Bu ko'rsatkich qancha odam kitob o'qishini ko'rsatadi.

words.definition: in addition to what has been said
words.example: Furthermore, the price includes breakfast.

words.definition: the final part of a speech or piece of writing
words.example: In conclusion, I think the plan will work.
words.exampleUz: Xulosa qilib aytganda, menimcha, reja ish beradi.

description: Shifokor maslahatini boshqaga yetkazish.
story: Shifokor ko'rigidan qaytdingiz va nima deganini aytib beryapsiz. Maslahatni yetkazishda har bir fe'lning o'z tuzilmasi bor: advise someone to do, suggest doing, recommend something.
grammarFocus: advise / suggest / recommend: She advised me to… / She suggested doing…

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: What did the doctor say at the clinic?
dialogue.uz: Klinikada shifokor nima dedi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: She advised me to see a specialist about my back.
dialogue.uz: U menga belim bo'yicha mutaxassisga ko'rinishni maslahat berdi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Did she give you a diagnosis?
dialogue.uz: Tashxis qo'ydimi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Not yet. She suggested doing a blood test and an X-ray first.
dialogue.uz: Hali yo'q. Avval qon tahlili va rentgen qilishni taklif qildi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Is it chronic?
dialogue.uz: Surunkalimi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: She doesn't think so. She recommended exercises as the first treatment, not surgery.
dialogue.uz: U unday deb o'ylamaydi. Birinchi davolash sifatida jarrohlik emas, mashqlarni tavsiya qildi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: How long will it take to recover?
dialogue.uz: Tuzalish qancha vaqt oladi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: About a month. She also reminded me to get my flu vaccine.
dialogue.uz: Taxminan bir oy. Gripp vaksinasini olishni ham eslatdi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Good. Prevention is always better than cure.
dialogue.uz: Yaxshi. Oldini olish har doim davolashdan yaxshiroq.

words.definition: a place where people go to see a doctor
words.example: The clinic is open until eight.

words.definition: a doctor who knows a lot about one part of medicine
words.example: You should see a heart specialist.

words.definition: the doctor’s decision about what illness someone has
words.example: The diagnosis was a simple infection.

words.definition: the red liquid that moves through your body
words.example: The nurse took a blood sample.

words.definition: lasting for a long time
words.example: He suffers from chronic back pain.
words.exampleUz: U surunkali bel og'rig'idan aziyat chekadi.

words.definition: medical care for an illness
words.example: The treatment lasted two weeks.

words.definition: medical treatment that involves cutting the body
words.example: She needs surgery on her knee.

words.definition: to become healthy again after an illness
words.example: It took him weeks to recover from flu.
words.exampleUz: Uning grippdan tuzalishi bir necha hafta oldi.

words.definition: a substance that protects you from a disease
words.example: The new vaccine is free for children.

words.definition: stopping something bad from happening
words.example: Prevention is better than cure.

description: Ikki turmush tarzini solishtirish.
story: Shaharda yoki qishloqda yashash yaxshiroqmi, degan bahs. Ikki narsa birga o'zgarishini ifodalash uchun the + qiyosiy daraja, the + qiyosiy daraja tuzilmasi ishlatiladi: the older I get, the more I love…
grammarFocus: the more…, the more… / the bigger…, the more…

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Would you rather live in the city or in the countryside?
dialogue.uz: Shahardami yoki qishloqda yashashni afzal ko'rasizmi?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: The older I get, the more I love the village. It's so peaceful.
dialogue.uz: Yoshim ulg'aygan sari qishloqni ko'proq yaxshi ko'raman. U yer juda osoyishta.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: But urban life is more convenient. Everything is close.
dialogue.uz: Lekin shahar hayoti qulayroq. Hammasi yaqin.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: True, but the bigger the city, the more overcrowded it becomes.
dialogue.uz: To'g'ri, lekin shahar qanchalik katta bo'lsa, shunchalik gavjum bo'ladi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Rural areas don't have good facilities, like hospitals and universities.
dialogue.uz: Qishloq joylarda kasalxona va universitet kabi yaxshi sharoitlar yo'q.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: That's changing. And the pace of life is slower there — the slower, the healthier.
dialogue.uz: Bu o'zgaryapti. U yerda hayot sur'ati sekinroq — qancha sekin bo'lsa, shuncha sog'lom.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: My grandparents keep livestock and grow their own food.
dialogue.uz: Buvim bilan bobom chorva boqishadi va o'z ovqatlarini o'zlari yetishtirishadi.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: That's exactly the lifestyle I dream about.
dialogue.uz: Men aynan shunday turmush tarzini orzu qilaman.

words.definition: land outside towns and cities
words.example: We spent the weekend in the countryside.
words.exampleUz: Dam olish kunlarini qishloq joyda o'tkazdik.

words.definition: quiet and calm
words.example: It is very peaceful by the lake.

words.definition: connected with a town or city
words.example: Urban areas are growing fast.

words.definition: easy to use or suitable for your plans
words.example: Is Monday convenient for you?

words.definition: with too many people in it
words.example: The buses are overcrowded in the morning.
words.exampleUz: Ertalab avtobuslar haddan ortiq gavjum bo'ladi.

words.definition: connected with the countryside
words.example: Many rural schools need new teachers.
words.exampleUz: Ko'plab qishloq maktablariga yangi o'qituvchilar kerak.

words.definition: a building or service for a particular purpose
words.example: The hotel has excellent sports facilities.

words.definition: the speed at which something happens
words.example: I like the slow pace of village life.
words.exampleUz: Qishloq hayotining sokin sur'ati menga yoqadi.

words.definition: animals kept on a farm
words.example: The family keeps sheep and other livestock.
words.exampleUz: Oila qo'y va boshqa chorva boqadi.

words.definition: the way a person lives
words.example: He changed his lifestyle after the illness.
words.exampleUz: Kasallikdan keyin u turmush tarzini o'zgartirdi.

description: Tarixiy shaharni ixcham va boy tilda tasvirlash.
story: Siz Xivada gid bo'lib ishlayapsiz. Rasmiy va ta'sirli tasvirda ikki gapni bitta qilish uchun sifatdosh oborotlari ishlatiladi: Built in…, Covered with…, Having crossed…
grammarFocus: Sifatdosh oborotlari: Built over 2,000 years ago, … / Having crossed the desert, …

dialogue.speaker: Guide
dialogue.en: Standing on this wall, you can see the whole of Khiva.
dialogue.uz: Bu devorda turib, butun Xivani ko'rishingiz mumkin.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.en: It's like a museum under the open sky. Is this a fortress?
dialogue.uz: Bu ochiq osmon ostidagi muzeyga o'xshaydi. Bu qal'ami?

dialogue.speaker: Guide
dialogue.en: Yes. Built over two thousand years ago, it protected the city from enemies.
dialogue.uz: Ha. Ikki ming yildan ko'proq avval qurilgan bu qal'a shaharni dushmanlardan himoya qilgan.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.en: And that tall tower?
dialogue.uz: Anavi baland minora-chi?

dialogue.speaker: Guide
dialogue.en: That's a minaret. Covered with blue and green tiles, it was never finished.
dialogue.uz: Bu minora. Ko'k va yashil koshinlar bilan qoplangan, u hech qachon tugatilmagan.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.en: Why was the city so rich?
dialogue.uz: Shahar nega bunchalik boy bo'lgan?

dialogue.speaker: Guide
dialogue.en: Because of trade. Having crossed the desert, every caravan stopped here.
dialogue.uz: Savdo sababli. Cho'lni kesib o'tgan har bir karvon shu yerda to'xtagan.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.en: What did the merchants sell?
dialogue.uz: Savdogarlar nima sotishgan?

dialogue.speaker: Guide
dialogue.en: Silk, spices and carpets. Today local families still preserve the old crafts.
dialogue.uz: Ipak, ziravorlar va gilamlar. Bugun ham mahalliy oilalar qadimiy hunarlarni saqlab kelmoqda.

dialogue.speaker: Tourist
dialogue.en: Then I must wander around the bazaar before I leave!
dialogue.uz: Unda ketishdan oldin bozorni aylanib chiqishim kerak!

words.definition: a large strong building used for defence
words.example: The old fortress stands on a hill.

words.definition: a tall thin tower next to a mosque
words.example: The Kalon Minaret is almost fifty metres high.
words.exampleUz: Minorai Kalon deyarli ellik metr baland.

words.definition: buying and selling goods
words.example: Trade between the two countries is growing.

words.definition: a group of people and animals travelling together
words.example: Caravans carried goods along the Silk Road.
words.exampleUz: Karvonlar Buyuk Ipak yo'li bo'ylab mol tashigan.

words.definition: a person who buys and sells goods

description: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarning ta'sirini tanqidiy muhokama qilish.
story: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda o'tkazgan vaqtingiz haqida gaplashyapsiz. a few / a little — "biroz, bir nechta" (ijobiy), few / little — "juda oz" (salbiy). few sanaladigan, little sanalmaydigan otlar bilan ishlatiladi.
grammarFocus: few / a few / little / a little

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: How much time do you spend on social media?
dialogue.uz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda qancha vaqt o'tkazasiz?

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Too much. I scroll for hours, but I learn very little.
dialogue.uz: Juda ko'p. Soatlab varaqlayman, lekin juda oz narsa o'rganaman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: It's addictive. The apps are designed to keep your attention.
dialogue.uz: Bu qaramlik uyg'otadi. Ilovalar e'tiboringizni ushlab turish uchun yaratilgan.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: And I compare myself with influencers all the time.
dialogue.uz: Va o'zimni doim influenserlar bilan solishtiraman.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: Remember, many photos use a filter. Few of them are authentic.
dialogue.uz: Unutmang, ko'p suratlarda filtr ishlatilgan. Ularning juda ozi haqiqiy.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: True. One influencer has a million followers but posts the same trend as everyone else.
dialogue.uz: To'g'ri. Bir influenserning million obunachisi bor, lekin hamma qatori bir xil trendni joylaydi.

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: I only follow a few accounts that teach something useful.
dialogue.uz: Men faqat foydali narsa o'rgatadigan bir nechta akkauntni kuzataman.

dialogue.speaker: Aziz
dialogue.en: Good idea. A little less screen time would help me too.
dialogue.uz: Yaxshi fikr. Ekran oldida biroz kamroq vaqt menga ham foydali bo'lardi.

words.definition: to move text on a screen up or down

words.definition: making you want to do something again and again

words.definition: a person who affects what their online followers buy or do
words.example: The influencer advertised a new phone.

words.definition: an effect that changes how a photo looks

words.definition: real and true, not copied or false
